risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp;         "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96;         "contents": "# Pilot Program: First 10 Merchants\n\n**Referral Voucher + Merchant Credit** — proof, learning, testimonials.  \nNot scale.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Merchant Selection Checklist\n\nUse this **before** outreach. A prospect must satisfy ALL in Section A and at least one in Section B.  \nIf any Section A item is NO → skip.\n\n### Section A — Must have (all YES)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Local or regional business (not national/global) | | |\n| 2 | High trust, repeat customers (regulars) | | |\n| 3 | Easy-to-understand service or product | | |\n| 4 | Owner involved in daily operations | | |\n| 5 | Comfortable with WhatsApp, phone, or email | | |\n\n### Section B — Best fit (at least one)\n\n| # | Category | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Café or coffee shop | |\n| 2 | Salon or barbershop | |\n| 3 | Gym or studio | |\n| 4 | Tool rental or service business | |\n| 5 | Small retail with regulars | |\n\n### Section C — Exclude (any YES → skip)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Big chain or franchise | |\n| 2 | Pure e‑commerce (no in‑person/regulars) | |\n| 3 | Discount‑driven / race‑to‑bottom positioning | |\n\n**Verdict:** _________________________________ (IN / OUT)  \n**Reason if OUT:** _________________________________\n\n---\n\n## 2. Outreach Script\n\n### 2a. Opening (DM / WhatsApp / SMS)\n\n&gt; I’m testing a new way to turn your regular customers into your best salespeople, without ads.  \n&gt; Can I show you in 10 minutes?\n\n*If they say yes:*  \n&gt; When’s a good 10‑minute slot this week? I can call or stop by.\n\n*If they ask “what is it?”:*  \n&gt; Your customers get a simple voucher to share. When someone uses it, you give the sharer a bit of store credit. You control the offer and the credit. I’ll set it up with you.\n\n---\n\n### 2b. Phone / in‑person (10‑minute show)\n\n**Minute 0–1 — Hook**  \n&gt; You know your best new customers usually come from people who already like you. We’re testing a simple system: your regulars share a voucher, their friend uses it, you decide how much credit the sharer gets. No ads, you stay in control.\n\n**Minute 2–4 — What they get**  \n&gt; You get one main voucher — e.g. “15% off first visit” — and one weekly drop: a limited batch, e.g. 30 vouchers for 48 hours. When a friend redeems, your staff confirms in one tap. The referrer gets credit you set — e.g. €5 — to spend with you.",

            "text": "**Reason if OUT:** _________________________________",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. Outreach Script",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2a. Opening (DM / WhatsApp / SMS)",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; I’m testing a new way to turn your regular customers into your best salespeople, without ads.  ",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; Can I show you in 10 minutes?",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "*If they say yes:*  ",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; When’s a good 10‑minute slot this week? I can call or stop by.",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "*If they ask “what is it?”:*  ",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; Your customers get a simple voucher to share. When someone uses it, you give the sharer a bit of store credit. You control the offer and the credit. I’ll set it up with you.",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2b. Phone / in‑person (10‑minute show)",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "**Minute 0–1 — Hook**  ",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; You know your best new customers usually come from people who already like you. We’re testing a simple system: your regulars share a voucher, their friend uses it, you decide how much credit the sharer gets. No ads, you stay in control.",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "**Minute 2–4 — What they get**  ",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; You get one main voucher — e.g. “15% off first visit” — and one weekly drop: a limited batch, e.g. 30 vouchers for 48 hours. When a friend redeems, your staff confirms in one tap. The referrer gets credit you set — e.g. €5 — to spend with you.",
            "lineNumber": 67
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.36474019289016724
    },

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Brand Positioning\n\n**Product name:** Vouchr  \n**Tagline:** Pay for results, not reach.\n\n---\n\n## One-paragraph positioning\n\nVouchr is merchant-owned referral infrastructure for local and regional businesses that rely on word-of-mouth. Instead of coupons, ads, or a marketplace, it lets you issue branded vouchers, turn loyal customers into a measurable, reward-based distribution channel, and pay them in your own store credit when their friends buy. You keep control of the brand and the relationship, and you only pay when a referred customer converts—not for clicks or impressions. Referral, measured and rewarded, for SMBs who want new customers and trust without losing control or budget to low-ROI ads.\n\n---\n\n## 10-second spoken pitch\n\n&gt; When a customer shares your voucher with a friend and that friend buys, the customer earns your store credit. It’s all branded, tracked, and controlled by you—and you only pay when it works.\n\n---\n\n## Homepage hero (1 sentence)\n\n&gt; Turn your best customers into your best salespeople—and only pay when it actually works.\n\n---\n\n## Core promise\n\n&gt; Turn your best customers into your best salespeople—and only pay when it actually works.\n\n---\n\n## What to say / not say\n\n**Never say:** discount platform, deal site, promo tool.  \n**Always say:** referral, credit, merchant-owned, pay-for-results.\n\n---\n\n## ICP\n\n- **Primary:** Local &amp; regional merchants (cafes, salons, gyms, rentals, services, retail); SMBs who rely on word-of-mouth; businesses tired of ads with unclear ROI.\n- **Secondary:** Franchise-style and multi-location SMBs.\n- **Not for:** Influencer marketers, big-brand ad buyers, discount hunters.\n\n---\n\n## Pricing positioning (no numbers)\n\n- Infrastructure, not marketing.\n- Cheaper than ads.\n- Pay only when value is created.  \n**Phrase:** \"You pay for customers, not clicks.\"\n\n---\n\n## Objection handling\n\n| Objection | Response |\n| --- | --- |\n| \"Isn't this just coupons?\" | No. Coupons discount. This rewards referrals. |\n| \"Will people abuse it?\" | Credits are locked, controlled, and merchant-specific. |",

Include the session cookie in requests.\n\n## Endpoints\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n#### Create Voucher\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nPOST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Merchant admin required\n\n**Body**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"type\": \"percentage\" | \"fixed_amount\" | \"credit_amount\",\n  \"value\": 1500,  // basis points for percentage, minor units for money\n  \"currency\": \"USD\",\n  \"validFrom\": \"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\n  \"validTo\": \"2024-01-31T23:59:59Z\",\n  \"usageLimitTotal\": 100,  // optional\n  \"usageLimitPerUser\": 1,  // optional\n  \"weeklyDropEnabled\": false,\n  \"weeklyDropJson\": {  // optional\n    \"dayOfWeek\": 1,\n    \"startTime\": \"10:00\",\n    \"stock\": 20,\n    \"durationMinutes\": 60\n  },\n  \"designJson\": {\n    \"headline\": \"15% Off\",\n    \"finePrint\": \"Valid for new customers\",\n    \"primaryColor\": \"#000000\",\n    \"secondaryColor\": \"#666666\",\n    \"backgroundColor\": \"#ffffff\"\n  },\n  \"codePrefix\": \"CH\"  // optional\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Response**: Voucher object\n\n#### List Vouchers\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nGET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Optional (public sees only published)\n\n**Response**: Array of voucher objects\n\n#### Get Voucher\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nGET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Required for non-published vouchers\n\n**Response**: Voucher object\n\n#### Update Voucher\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nPUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Merchant admin required\n\n**Body**: (all fields optional)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"status\": \"draft\" | \"published\" | \"paused\" | \"ended\",\n  \"type\": \"percentage\" | \"fixed_amount\" | \"credit_amount\",\n  \"value\": 1500,\n  \"currency\": \"USD\",\n  \"validFrom\": \"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\n  \"validTo\": \"2024-01-31T23:59:59Z\",\n  \"usageLimitTotal\": 100,\n  \"usageLimitPerUser\": 1,\n  \"weeklyDropEnabled\": false,\n  \"weeklyDropJson\": {...},\n  \"designJson\": {...},\n  \"codePrefix\": \"CH\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "**Minute 0–1 — Hook**  \n&gt; You know your best new customers usually come from people who already like you. We’re testing a simple system: your regulars share a voucher, their friend uses it, you decide how much credit the sharer gets. No ads, you stay in control.\n\n**Minute 2–4 — What they get**  \n&gt; You get one main voucher — e.g. “15% off first visit” — and one weekly drop: a limited batch, e.g. 30 vouchers for 48 hours. When a friend redeems, your staff confirms in one tap. The referrer gets credit you set — e.g. €5 — to spend with you.\n\n**Minute 5–7 — Why pilot**  \n&gt; I’m running this with 10 local businesses to see what works. For the pilot it’s free, I do the setup with you, and you get your own branded voucher. In return I’d want a short feedback call and, if it works, your okay to use the results.\n\n**Minute 8–10 — Close**  \n&gt; No contract. If it doesn’t fit, we stop. Want to try it for a few weeks?\n\n---\n\n### 2c. Do NOT say\n\n- “startup”\n- “beta”\n- “platform”\n- “app”\n\nUse: “we’re testing,” “system,” “voucher,” “credit,” “weekly drop.”\n\n---\n\n### 2d. Objection short replies\n\n| Objection | Reply |\n| --- | --- |\n| “I don’t have time.” | “Setup is one short session. After that it runs itself. 10 minutes to see it?” |\n| “Will it cost me?” | “Pilot is free. If we continue after, it would be a small monthly fee and a small amount per referral. We can talk then.” |\n| “My customers won’t share.” | “That’s what we’re testing. If almost no one shares, we’ll change the offer or drop it. No risk for you.” |\n| “I already have loyalty / discounts.” | “This is different: they only get credit when they bring a new person who actually shows up. It rewards bringing new customers.” |\n\n---\n\n## 3. Pilot Setup Checklist (per merchant)\n\nDo this in one session. Check each when done.\n\n### Before the session\n\n| # | Task | ✓ |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Merchant has accepted pilot (verbal or short written ok) | |\n| 2 | You have: business name, main offer in one sentence, contact for staff | |",

        "contents": "Ei mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena\n\nKui UI on ilus, aga aeglane → vale.\n\n## 8) PWA REEGLID\n\nInstallitav\n\nNative share (mobile)\n\nOffline QR juba avatud voucheritele\n\niOS &amp; Android browser support\n\n## 9) LOGGING &amp; AUDIT\n\nKõik admin/staff tegevused → AuditLog\n\nÄra logi tundlikke andmeid\n\nRiskisündmused märgista (fraud flags)\n\n## 10) DONE DEFINITSIOON (ABSOLUUTNE)\n\nMVP on DONE, kui lokaalselt seed’iga:\n\nAvan voucheri\n\nLoon referral’i\n\nJagan linki\n\nFriend redeem’ib\n\nStaff kinnitab\n\nCredit tekib locked\n\nCredit unlock’itakse\n\nCredit kasutatakse demo checkout’is\n\nKui üks samm ei tööta → NOT DONE.\n\n## 11) KEEELUD (AUTOMAATNE STOPP)\n\nCursor EI TOHI:\n\nlisada uusi lehti\n\nlisada uusi rolle\n\nlisada uusi tasemeid\n\nlisada analytics’e “niisama”\n\n“parandada UX-i” scope’i laiendades\n\nKui tekib kiusatus → kirjuta V2 backlog’isse, ära ehita.\n\n## 12) BUILD ORDER (JÄRGI)\n\nPrisma schema + migrations\n\nAuth + RBAC + tenancy\n\nPublic voucher &amp; referral pages\n\nMerchant voucher builder\n\nRedemption + credit pipeline\n\nWallet UI\n\nPWA polish\n\nTests + seed + docs\n\n## 13) SUHTLUSREEGEL\n\nKui midagi on ebaselge → küsi\n\nKui miski ei mahu MVP-sse → ära tee\n\nKui reegel on vastuolus ideega → idee kaotab\n\n## 14) FILOSOOFIA\n\nSee projekt ei võida müraga.\nSee võidab selguse, distsipliini ja usaldusega.\n\nBuild infrastructure.\nNot hype.",

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### C) Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ Redemption form on &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ POST to &#96;/api/redemptions&#96;\n- ✅ Creates locked credit\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### D) Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ Confirm button on &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n- ✅ POST to &#96;/api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### E) Credit unlocks\n- ✅ &#96;unlockCreditForRedemption()&#96; in &#96;lib/credits.ts&#96;\n- ✅ Called after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### F) User applies credit in checkout demo\n- ✅ Checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n- ✅ Apply credit endpoint: &#96;/api/credits/apply&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n## ✅ Data Model Compliance\n\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules enforced:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money (per-merchant, expires)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral (checked in redemption flow)\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n## ✅ Security &amp; Fraud\n\n- ✅ Rate limiting (&#96;lib/fraud.ts&#96;)\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics (rate limits)\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers (&#96;friendHash&#96; in Referral)\n- ✅ Audit log for admin/staff actions\n\n## ✅ PWA Requirements\n\n- ✅ &#96;manifest.json&#96; present\n- ✅ Service worker (&#96;public/sw.js&#96;)\n- ✅ Offline QR code generation\n- ✅ Installable (manifest configured)\n- ⚠️ Need to verify iOS compatibility\n\n## ❌ Forbidden Features Check\n\nSearched for forbidden terms:\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI features\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## 🎯 Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove or hide non-MVP pages:**\n   - &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - Remove or hide from nav",

        "contents": "- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event\n\n### Tickets\n\n- &#96;POST /api/tickets/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Campaign&#96;: Campaign definitions (pricing, limits, credit percentages)\n- &#96;VoucherPurchase&#96;: Voucher purchase records\n- &#96;Event&#96;: Event definitions\n- &#96;Ticket&#96;: Ticket instances for events\n- &#96;TicketPurchase&#96;: Ticket purchase records\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances\n- &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records\n- &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions\n- &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records\n- &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail\n\nSee &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.\n\n## Business Rules\n\n1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn\n2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific\n3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)\n4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals\n5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation\n6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically\n7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced\n\n## Testing\n\nRun tests:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm test\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables",

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96;         "contents": "6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)\n\n## 📋 Done Definition Verification\n\nTo verify MVP is complete, test locally:\n\n1. ✅ Open voucher page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. ✅ Create referral (click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\")\n3. ✅ Share link (native share or copy)\n4. ✅ Friend redeems (open link in incognito, redeem)\n5. ✅ Staff confirms (go to redemptions, click confirm)\n6. ✅ Credit appears locked (check wallet)\n7. ✅ Credit unlocks (after confirmation, check wallet)\n8. ✅ Credit applied in checkout demo (go to checkout-demo, apply credit)\n\n## 🎯 Launch Readiness\n\n### Ready\n- ✅ Core flows working\n- ✅ MVP pages complete\n- ✅ Security &amp; fraud prevention\n- ✅ PWA functional\n- ✅ Data model correct\n- ✅ Business rules enforced\n\n### Needs Attention\n- ⚠️ Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page\n- ⚠️ Test all 8 done definition steps\n- ⚠️ Verify iOS PWA compatibility\n- ⚠️ Add feature flags (launch mode)\n\n### V2 (Documented Only)\n- 📝 See &#96;V2_BACKLOG.md&#96;\n- 📝 See &#96;LAUNCH_MODE.md&#96;\n\n## Summary\n\n**Status**: ✅ **MVP COMPLIANT** (with minor cleanup needed)\n\nThe platform matches the specification.         "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96;         "contents": "Ei mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena\n\nKui UI on ilus, aga aeglane → vale.\n\n## 8) PWA REEGLID\n\nInstallitav\n\nNative share (mobile)\n\nOffline QR juba avatud voucheritele\n\niOS &amp; Android browser support\n\n## 9) LOGGING &amp; AUDIT\n\nKõik admin/staff tegevused → AuditLog\n\nÄra logi tundlikke andmeid\n\nRiskisündmused märgista (fraud flags)\n\n## 10) DONE DEFINITSIOON (ABSOLUUTNE)\n\nMVP on DONE, kui lokaalselt seed’iga:\n\nAvan voucheri\n\nLoon referral’i\n\nJagan linki\n\nFriend redeem’ib\n\nStaff kinnitab\n\nCredit tekib locked\n\nCredit unlock’itakse\n\nCredit kasutatakse demo checkout’is\n\nKui üks samm ei tööta → NOT DONE.\n\n## 11) KEEELUD (AUTOMAATNE STOPP)\n\nCursor EI TOHI:\n\nlisada uusi lehti\n\nlisada uusi rolle\n\nlisada uusi tasemeid\n\nlisada analytics’e “niisama”\n\n“parandada UX-i” scope’i laiendades\n\nKui tekib kiusatus → kirjuta V2 backlog’isse, ära ehita.\n\n## 12) BUILD ORDER (JÄRGI)\n\nPrisma schema + migrations\n\nAuth + RBAC + tenancy\n\nPublic voucher &amp; referral pages\n\nMerchant voucher builder\n\nRedemption + credit pipeline\n\nWallet UI\n\nPWA polish\n\nTests + seed + docs\n\n## 13) SUHTLUSREEGEL\n\nKui midagi on ebaselge → küsi\n\nKui miski ei mahu MVP-sse → ära tee\n\nKui reegel on vastuolus ideega → idee kaotab\n\n## 14) FILOSOOFIA\n\nSee projekt ei võida müraga.\nSee võidab selguse, distsipliini ja usaldusega.\n\nBuild infrastructure.\nNot hype.",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works\n- [ ] Magic link emails sent\n- [ ] OAuth providers work (if configured)\n- [ ] Voucher pages load\n- [ ] Referral pages load\n- [ ] PWA installable\n- [ ] Service worker active\n\n#### Test Core Flows\n- [ ] Create voucher\n- [ ] Create campaign\n- [ ] Generate vouchers from campaign\n- [ ] Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- [ ] Publish voucher\n- [ ] Share referral\n- [ ] Redeem voucher\n- [ ] Confirm redemption\n- [ ] Credit unlocks\n- [ ] Apply credit\n- [ ] Create event\n- [ ] Generate tickets for event\n- [ ] Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n#### Monitor\n- [ ] Error logs checked\n- [ ] Performance metrics reviewed\n- [ ] Database connections stable\n- [ ] API response times acceptable\n\n## Launch Mode Setup\n\n### Initial Setup\n- [ ] Run launch mode migration\n- [ ] Create first merchant via database\n- [ ] Add merchant admin user\n- [ ] Test merchant dashboard access\n- [ ] Verify kill switch works\n\n### Merchant Onboarding\n- [ ] Document onboarding process\n- [ ] Create merchant invite template\n- [ ] Set up merchant creation workflow\n- [ ] Test feature flags\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Set Up\n- [ ] Error tracking (Sentry, etc.)\n- [ ] Performance monitoring\n- [ ] Database monitoring\n- [ ] Uptime monitoring\n- [ ] Log aggregation\n\n### Alerts\n- [ ] Database connection failures\n- [ ] High error rates\n- [ ] Slow API responses\n- [ ] Merchant deactivations\n- [ ] Unusual redemption patterns\n\n## Rollback Plan\n\n### If Issues Occur\n1. **Immediate**: Deactivate problematic merchants via kill switch\n2. **Short-term**: Revert deployment if critical bug\n3. **Long-term**: Fix issue and redeploy\n\n### Rollback Steps\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Revert code deployment\n# 2. Check database migrations (may need to rollback)\n# 3. Verify environment variables\n# 4. Test critical flows\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Post-Launch\n\n### Week 1\n- [ ] Monitor error rates daily\n- [ ] Review user feedback\n- [ ] Check performance metrics\n- [ ] Verify all core flows work\n- [ ] Test on multiple devices/browsers\n\n### Week 2-4",

        "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

                  "content": "       * Use &#96;allow_incomplete&#96; to create Subscriptions with &#96;status=incomplete&#96; if the first invoice can't be paid. Creating Subscriptions with this status allows you to manage scenarios where additional customer actions are needed to pay a subscription's invoice. For example, SCA regulation may require 3DS authentication to complete payment. See the [SCA Migration Guide](https://stripe.com/docs/billing/migration/strong-customer-authentication) for Billing to learn more. This is the default behavior."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 138,
                  "content": "       * Use &#96;default_incomplete&#96; to create Subscriptions with &#96;status=incomplete&#96; when the first invoice requires payment, otherwise start as active. Subscriptions transition to &#96;status=active&#96; when successfully confirming the PaymentIntent on the first invoice. This allows simpler management of scenarios where additional customer actions are needed to pay a subscription's invoice, such as failed payments, [SCA regulation](https://stripe.com/docs/billing/migration/strong-customer-authentication), or collecting a mandate for a bank debit payment method. If the PaymentIntent is not confirmed within 23 hours Subscriptions transition to &#96;status=incomplete_expired&#96;, which is a terminal state."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 140,
                  "content": "       * Use &#96;error_if_incomplete&#96; if you want Stripe to return an HTTP 402 status code if a subscription's first invoice can't be paid. For example, if a payment method requires 3DS authentication due to SCA regulation and further customer action is needed, this parameter doesn't create a Subscription and returns an error instead. This was the default behavior for API versions prior to 2019-03-14. See the [changelog](https://stripe.com/docs/upgrades#2019-03-14) to learn more."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 142,
                  "content": "       * &#96;pending_if_incomplete&#96; is only used with updates and cannot be passed when creating a Subscription."

        "contents": "# Ideed täiustamiseks\n\n## 🎯 Prioriteet 1: Praktilised täiustused\n\n### 1. Voucher Otsing &amp; Filtreerimine ⭐⭐⭐\n- Otsing välja (headline, code prefix)\n- Filtreerimine: status, type, date range\n- Sortimine: date, name, redemptions\n- Pagination suurtele listidele\n\n### 2. Referral Analytics ⭐⭐⭐\n- Kui palju jagatud\n- Kui palju avatud\n- Conversion rate (opened → redeemed)\n- Top referrers\n- Referral timeline\n\n### 4. Navigation &amp; Breadcrumbs ⭐⭐\n- Breadcrumb navigation\n- Mobile-friendly sidebar\n- Quick actions menu\n- User profile dropdown\n\n### 5. Export Funktsioonid ⭐⭐\n- Redemptions CSV export\n- Credits ledger export\n- Vouchers list export\n- Analytics reports\n\n## 🎯 Prioriteet 2: Email &amp; Notifications\n\n### 6. Email Notifications ⭐⭐⭐\n- Credit unlock notifications\n- Redemption confirmations\n- Weekly drop reminders\n- Credit expiry warnings (7 days, 1 day)\n- Welcome emails\n\n### 7.         "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "range": {

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Launch Mode Configuration",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "Per specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Current Implementation",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "### Platform Admin",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### Merchant Member Management",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access**: Merchant admin only",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Feature Flags (To Implement)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "The specification requires:",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- Feature flags per merchant",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- Kill switch per merchant",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Invite-only merchant signup",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### Recommended Implementation",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "// Add to Merchant model",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "model Merchant {",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  // ... existing fields",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### Feature Flag Examples",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## Manual Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "To disable a merchant:",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "This should:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hide merchant from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- Prevent new voucher creation",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allow existing redemptions to complete",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Log action in AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "## No Public Signup",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public merchant signup form",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96;       "codeBlock": {

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 46
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Changelog",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "### Added",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {

        "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        },
        "contents": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide\n\nThis guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;\n\n2. Regenerate Prisma client:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma generate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kill Switch\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:\n- Merchant is hidden from public routes\n- New voucher creation is blocked\n- Existing redemptions can complete\n- All actions are logged to AuditLog\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Deactivate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)\nawait deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Activate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Activate merchant\nawait activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // ... auth checks ...\n  \n  // Check merchant is active\n  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n  \n  // Continue with voucher creation...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SQL Direct Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Activate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Check status\nSELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Feature Flags\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

            "text": "This guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.",

            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Prerequisites",
            "lineNumber": 5

            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:",
            "lineNumber": 7

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "npx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode",

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "Or manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },

            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Regenerate Prisma client:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },

            "text": "npx prisma generate",

          },

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",

          },
          {
            "text": "### How It Works",

            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)",

          },
          {
            "text": "await deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Activate a Merchant",

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {",

          {
