Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works\n- [ ] Magic link emails sent\n- [ ] OAuth providers work (if configured)\n- [ ] Voucher pages load\n- [ ] Referral pages load\n- [ ] PWA installable\n- [ ] Service worker active\n\n#### Test Core Flows\n- [ ] Create voucher\n- [ ] Create campaign\n- [ ] Generate vouchers from campaign\n- [ ] Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- [ ] Publish voucher\n- [ ] Share referral\n- [ ] Redeem voucher\n- [ ] Confirm redemption\n- [ ] Credit unlocks\n- [ ] Apply credit\n- [ ] Create event\n- [ ] Generate tickets for event\n- [ ] Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n#### Monitor\n- [ ] Error logs checked\n- [ ] Performance metrics reviewed\n- [ ] Database connections stable\n- [ ] API response times acceptable\n\n## Launch Mode Setup\n\n### Initial Setup\n- [ ] Run launch mode migration\n- [ ] Create first merchant via database\n- [ ] Add merchant admin user\n- [ ] Test merchant dashboard access\n- [ ] Verify kill switch works\n\n### Merchant Onboarding\n- [ ] Document onboarding process\n- [ ] Create merchant invite template\n- [ ] Set up merchant creation workflow\n- [ ] Test feature flags\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Set Up\n- [ ] Error tracking (Sentry, etc.)\n- [ ] Performance monitoring\n- [ ] Database monitoring\n- [ ] Uptime monitoring\n- [ ] Log aggregation\n\n### Alerts\n- [ ] Database connection failures\n- [ ] High error rates\n- [ ] Slow API responses\n- [ ] Merchant deactivations\n- [ ] Unusual redemption patterns\n\n## Rollback Plan\n\n### If Issues Occur\n1. **Immediate**: Deactivate problematic merchants via kill switch\n2. **Short-term**: Revert deployment if critical bug\n3. **Long-term**: Fix issue and redeploy\n\n### Rollback Steps\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1.         "contents": "Ei mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena\n\nKui UI on ilus, aga aeglane → vale.\n\n## 8) PWA REEGLID\n\nInstallitav\n\nNative share (mobile)\n\nOffline QR juba avatud voucheritele\n\niOS &amp; Android browser support\n\n## 9) LOGGING &amp; AUDIT\n\nKõik admin/staff tegevused → AuditLog\n\nÄra logi tundlikke andmeid\n\nRiskisündmused märgista (fraud flags)\n\n## 10) DONE DEFINITSIOON (ABSOLUUTNE)\n\nMVP on DONE, kui lokaalselt seed’iga:\n\nAvan voucheri\n\nLoon referral’i\n\nJagan linki\n\nFriend redeem’ib\n\nStaff kinnitab\n\nCredit tekib locked\n\nCredit unlock’itakse\n\nCredit kasutatakse demo checkout’is\n\nKui üks samm ei tööta → NOT DONE.\n\n## 11) KEEELUD (AUTOMAATNE STOPP)\n\nCursor EI TOHI:\n\nlisada uusi lehti\n\nlisada uusi rolle\n\nlisada uusi tasemeid\n\nlisada analytics’e “niisama”\n\n“parandada UX-i” scope’i laiendades\n\nKui tekib kiusatus → kirjuta V2 backlog’isse, ära ehita.\n\n## 12) BUILD ORDER (JÄRGI)\n\nPrisma schema + migrations\n\nAuth + RBAC + tenancy\n\nPublic voucher &amp; referral pages\n\nMerchant voucher builder\n\nRedemption + credit pipeline\n\nWallet UI\n\nPWA polish\n\nTests + seed + docs\n\n## 13) SUHTLUSREEGEL\n\nKui midagi on ebaselge → küsi\n\nKui miski ei mahu MVP-sse → ära tee\n\nKui reegel on vastuolus ideega → idee kaotab\n\n## 14) FILOSOOFIA\n\nSee projekt ei võida müraga.\nSee võidab selguse, distsipliini ja usaldusega.\n\nBuild infrastructure.\nNot hype.",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide\n\nThis guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;\n\n2. Regenerate Prisma client:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma generate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kill Switch\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:\n- Merchant is hidden from public routes\n- New voucher creation is blocked\n- Existing redemptions can complete\n- All actions are logged to AuditLog\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Deactivate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)\nawait deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Activate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Activate merchant\nawait activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // ... auth checks ...\n  \n  // Check merchant is active\n  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n  \n  // Continue with voucher creation...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SQL Direct Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Activate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Check status\nSELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Feature Flags\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

            "text": "// Add to Merchant model",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "model Merchant {",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  // ... existing fields",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### Feature Flag Examples",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## Manual Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "To disable a merchant:",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "This should:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hide merchant from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- Prevent new voucher creation",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allow existing redemptions to complete",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Log action in AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "## No Public Signup",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public merchant signup form",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          }
        ]

        "contents": "The &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { isFeatureEnabled } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Check if weekly drops are enabled for merchant\nconst weeklyDropsEnabled = await isFeatureEnabled(merchantId, 'weeklyDropsEnabled');\n\nif (weeklyDropsEnabled) {\n  // Show weekly drop options\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Set Feature Flags\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Enable weekly drops for a merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = jsonb_set(\n  COALESCE(\"featureFlags\", '{}'::jsonb),\n  '{weeklyDropsEnabled}',\n  'true'::jsonb\n)\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Disable a feature\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = jsonb_set(\n  COALESCE(\"featureFlags\", '{}'::jsonb),\n  '{weeklyDropsEnabled}',\n  'false'::jsonb\n)\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Set multiple flags\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = '{\"weeklyDropsEnabled\": true, \"analyticsEnabled\": false}'::jsonb\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Available Feature Flags\n\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; - Enable weekly drop functionality\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; - Enable analytics dashboard (V2)\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled&#96; - Enable custom domains (V2)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled&#96; - Enable white-label mode (V2)\n\n## Integration Points\n\n### Where to Add Kill Switch Checks\n\nAdd &#96;requireActiveMerchant()&#96; checks to:\n\n1. **Voucher Creation** (&#96;app/api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Block new vouchers for inactive merchants\n\n2. **Voucher Publishing** (&#96;app/api/vouchers/[id]/publish/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Block publishing for inactive merchants\n\n3. **Public Voucher Pages** (&#96;app/v/[id]/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Hide vouchers from inactive merchants\n\n4. **Public Referral Pages** (&#96;app/r/[id]/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Hide referrals from inactive merchants\n\n5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning",

        "contents": "# V2 Backlog\n\n**DO NOT BUILD** - These features are explicitly forbidden in MVP and should only be documented for future consideration.\n\n## Forbidden Features (Per Specification)\n\n### Marketplace &amp; Discovery\n- ❌ Public marketplace/feed of vouchers\n- ❌ Deals feed\n- ❌ Ad network\n- ❌ Social platform features\n\n### Social Features\n- ❌ Comments on vouchers\n- ❌ Likes/reactions\n- ❌ Social sharing beyond native share sheet\n- ❌ User profiles/public pages\n\n### Loyalty &amp; Tiers\n- ❌ Loyalty tiers/levels\n- ❌ Points systems\n- ❌ Gamification\n\n### AI Features\n- ❌ AI-powered recommendations\n- ❌ AI-generated voucher designs\n- ❌ AI content generation\n\n### Advertising\n- ❌ Ad placements\n- ❌ Sponsored vouchers\n- ❌ Third-party advertising\n\n### Influencer Features\n- ❌ Influencer dashboards\n- ❌ Influencer-specific tools\n- ❌ Creator monetization\n\n## Potential V2 Features (Document Only)\n\nThese were mentioned in the specification as V2 backlog items:\n\n1. **Apple Wallet / Google Wallet**\n   - Add vouchers to native wallet apps\n   - QR codes in wallet format\n\n2. **Push Notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n   - Credit expiry warnings\n\n3. **Multi-language Selector**\n   - User-selectable language (beyond browser detection)\n   - Language preferences per user\n\n4. **Custom Domains**\n   - Merchant-branded domains\n   - White-label subdomains\n\n5. **POS Deep Integrations**\n   - Direct POS system integration\n   - Real-time inventory sync\n   - Automated redemption confirmation\n\n6. **Analytics Exports**\n   - PDF reports\n   - CSV exports (already have for redemptions)\n   - Scheduled reports\n\n7. **White-label Mode**\n   - Fully branded merchant experience\n   - Remove platform branding\n   - Custom email templates\n\n## Current Non-MVP Pages (For Reference)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in MVP scope:\n\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Platform admin (internal use for launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - Analytics dashboard (V2)",

        "contents": "1. **Always check &#96;isActive&#96; before allowing writes** - Prevents creating vouchers for inactive merchants\n2. **Log all kill switch actions** - Use &#96;deactivateMerchant()&#96; and &#96;activateMerchant()&#96; functions\n3. **Test feature flags** - Verify flags work before enabling for all merchants\n4. **Monitor audit logs** - Track who activated/deactivated merchants\n5. **Graceful degradation** - Inactive merchants should see clear messages, not errors\n\n## Emergency Procedures\n\n### Emergency Deactivation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Immediately deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'problematic-merchant';\n\n-- This will:\n-- - Block new voucher creation\n-- - Hide from public routes\n-- - Allow existing redemptions to complete\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Reactivation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Reactivate after issue resolved\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'problematic-merchant';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Next Steps\n\n1. Run migration: &#96;npx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode&#96;\n2. Integrate &#96;requireActiveMerchant()&#96; into API routes\n3. Add feature flag checks where needed\n4.         "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning\n\n### Where to Add Feature Flag Checks\n\nAdd feature flag checks to:\n\n1. **Weekly Drop Claim** (&#96;app/api/weekly-drop/claim/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; flag\n\n2. **Voucher Builder** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Show/hide weekly drop options based on flag\n\n3. **Analytics Dashboard** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/analytics/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; flag (V2)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n### Step 1: Create Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nINSERT INTO \"Merchant\" (id, name, slug, country, \"defaultCurrency\", \"isActive\", \"invitedAt\")\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  'New Merchant',\n  'new-merchant',\n  'US',\n  'USD',\n  true,\n  NOW()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Add Merchant Admin\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- First, create or find user\nINSERT INTO \"User\" (id, email, name, \"emailVerified\")\nVALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'admin@new-merchant.com', 'Admin', NOW())\nON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;\n\n-- Add as merchant admin\nINSERT INTO \"MerchantMember\" (id, \"merchantId\", \"userId\", role)\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  (SELECT id FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE slug = 'new-merchant'),\n  (SELECT id FROM \"User\" WHERE email = 'admin@new-merchant.com'),\n  'merchant_admin'\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Mark Onboarded\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"onboardedAt\" = NOW()\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'new-merchant';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Check Merchant Status\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  name,\n  slug,\n  \"isActive\",\n  \"invitedAt\",\n  \"onboardedAt\",\n  \"featureFlags\"\nFROM \"Merchant\"\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Audit Log\n\nAll kill switch actions are logged:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  \"createdAt\",\n  action,\n  \"payloadJson\"\nFROM \"AuditLog\"\nWHERE action IN ('merchant_activated', 'merchant_deactivated')\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Always check &#96;isActive&#96; before allowing writes** - Prevents creating vouchers for inactive merchants\n2. **Log all kill switch actions** - Use &#96;deactivateMerchant()&#96; and &#96;activateMerchant()&#96; functions",
        "signatures": {},

            "text": "1. **Weekly Drop Claim** (&#96;app/api/weekly-drop/claim/route.ts&#96;)",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Voucher Builder** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;)",

          },

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "   - Check &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; flag (V2)",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "## Manual Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 1: Create Merchant",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "INSERT INTO \"Merchant\" (id, name, slug, country, \"defaultCurrency\", \"isActive\", \"invitedAt\")",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "VALUES (",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "  gen_random_uuid()::text,",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "  'New Merchant',",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "  'new-merchant',",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "  'US',",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "  'USD',",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "  true,",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "  NOW()",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 2: Add Merchant Admin",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "-- First, create or find user",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "INSERT INTO \"User\" (id, email, name, \"emailVerified\")",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'admin@new-merchant.com', 'Admin', NOW())",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Add as merchant admin",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "INSERT INTO \"MerchantMember\" (id, \"merchantId\", \"userId\", role)",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "VALUES (",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "  gen_random_uuid()::text,",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "  (SELECT id FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE slug = 'new-merchant'),",

          },
          {
            "text": "  (SELECT id FROM \"User\" WHERE email = 'admin@new-merchant.com'),",

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 3: Mark Onboarded",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" ",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "SET \"onboardedAt\" = NOW()",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "WHERE \"slug\" = 'new-merchant';",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 208
          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",

          },
          {
            "text": "SELECT ",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "  slug,",

          },
          {
            "text": "  \"isActive\",",

          },
          {
            "text": "  \"invitedAt\",",

          },
          {

          },

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "### Audit Log",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "All kill switch actions are logged:",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "SELECT ",

          },
          {
            "text": "  \"createdAt\",",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

            "text": "## Best Practices",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise staatus\n\n## ✅ Valmis\n\n1. **i18n konfiguratsioon**\n   - ✅ 5 keelt: en, et, es, fr, de\n   - ✅ Routing konfiguratsioon\n   - ✅ Middleware locale detection'iga\n\n2. **Tõlked**\n   - ✅ Inglise (en) - täielik\n   - ✅ Eesti (et) - täielik\n   - ✅ Hispaania (es) - täielik\n   - ✅ Prantsuse (fr) - täielik\n   - ✅ Saksa (de) - täielik\n\n3. **Komponendid**\n   - ✅ Language selector\n   - ✅ Locale-aware layout\n   - ✅ i18n utilities (valuuta, kuupäevad)\n\n4. **Dokumentatsioon**\n   - ✅ I18N_GUIDE.md - täielik juhend\n\n## ⚠️ Vajab täiendamist\n\n### 1. Olemasolevate lehtede migreerimine\n\nPraegu on palju lehti, mis ei kasuta tõlkeid. Need tuleb järk-järgult migreerida:\n\n**Prioriteet 1 (kõrge):**\n- &#96;app/login/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 2 (keskmine):**\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/dashboard/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet/page.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 3 (madal):**\n- Kõik ülejäänud lehed\n\n### 2. Kuidas migreerida lehte\n\n1. **Lisa &#96;useTranslations&#96; hook**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n   \n   const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Asenda hardcoded stringid**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // Enne:\n   &lt;h1&gt;Vouchers&lt;/h1&gt;\n   \n   // Pärast:\n   &lt;h1&gt;{t('vouchers')}&lt;/h1&gt;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Kasuta &#96;Link&#96; komponenti &#96;@/routing&#96;'ist**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { Link } from '@/routing';\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. URL struktuur\n\nPraegu:\n- &#96;/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (inglise keel)\n- &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (eesti keel)\n- &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (hispaania keel)\n\nKõik lehed peaksid toetama locale prefix'it.\n\n## 📝 Järgmised sammud\n\n1. **Migreeri kõige kasutatavamad lehed** (login, voucher, referral)\n2. **Testi kõik keeled**\n3. **Lisa puuduvad tõlked** (kui vaja)\n4. **Paranda URL struktuuri** (kui vaja)\n\n## 🎯 Eesmärk",

        "contents": "Ei mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena\n\nKui UI on ilus, aga aeglane → vale.\n\n## 8) PWA REEGLID\n\nInstallitav\n\nNative share (mobile)\n\nOffline QR juba avatud voucheritele\n\niOS &amp; Android browser support\n\n## 9) LOGGING &amp; AUDIT\n\nKõik admin/staff tegevused → AuditLog\n\nÄra logi tundlikke andmeid\n\nRiskisündmused märgista (fraud flags)\n\n## 10) DONE DEFINITSIOON (ABSOLUUTNE)\n\nMVP on DONE, kui lokaalselt seed’iga:\n\nAvan voucheri\n\nLoon referral’i\n\nJagan linki\n\nFriend redeem’ib\n\nStaff kinnitab\n\nCredit tekib locked\n\nCredit unlock’itakse\n\nCredit kasutatakse demo checkout’is\n\nKui üks samm ei tööta → NOT DONE.\n\n## 11) KEEELUD (AUTOMAATNE STOPP)\n\nCursor EI TOHI:\n\nlisada uusi lehti\n\nlisada uusi rolle\n\nlisada uusi tasemeid\n\nlisada analytics’e “niisama”\n\n“parandada UX-i” scope’i laiendades\n\nKui tekib kiusatus → kirjuta V2 backlog’isse, ära ehita.\n\n## 12) BUILD ORDER (JÄRGI)\n\nPrisma schema + migrations\n\nAuth + RBAC + tenancy\n\nPublic voucher &amp; referral pages\n\nMerchant voucher builder\n\nRedemption + credit pipeline\n\nWallet UI\n\nPWA polish\n\nTests + seed + docs\n\n## 13) SUHTLUSREEGEL\n\nKui midagi on ebaselge → küsi\n\nKui miski ei mahu MVP-sse → ära tee\n\nKui reegel on vastuolus ideega → idee kaotab\n\n## 14) FILOSOOFIA\n\nSee projekt ei võida müraga.\nSee võidab selguse, distsipliini ja usaldusega.\n\nBuild infrastructure.\nNot hype.",

in &#96;lib/credits.ts&#96;\n- ✅ Called after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### F) User applies credit in checkout demo\n- ✅ Checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n- ✅ Apply credit endpoint: &#96;/api/credits/apply&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n## ✅ Data Model Compliance\n\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules enforced:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money (per-merchant, expires)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral (checked in redemption flow)\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n## ✅ Security &amp; Fraud\n\n- ✅ Rate limiting (&#96;lib/fraud.ts&#96;)\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics (rate limits)\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers (&#96;friendHash&#96; in Referral)\n- ✅ Audit log for admin/staff actions\n\n## ✅ PWA Requirements\n\n- ✅ &#96;manifest.json&#96; present\n- ✅ Service worker (&#96;public/sw.js&#96;)\n- ✅ Offline QR code generation\n- ✅ Installable (manifest configured)\n- ⚠️ Need to verify iOS compatibility\n\n## ❌ Forbidden Features Check\n\nSearched for forbidden terms:\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96;         "contents": "# Deployment Checklist\n\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\n\n## Pre-Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables\n- [ ] &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\n- [ ] &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; - Random 32+ character string\n- [ ] &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_HOST&#96; - Email server for magic links\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PORT&#96; - Email server port\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_USER&#96; - Email server username\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&#96; - Email server password\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_FROM&#96; - From email address\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_API_KEY&#96; - Resend API key (recommended for transactional emails)\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_FROM_EMAIL&#96; - Default \"from\" address for Resend\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_SECRET_KEY&#96; - Stripe secret key (required for payments)\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET&#96; - Stripe webhook signing secret (required for webhooks)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY&#96; - Stripe publishable key (client-side)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth client ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_SECRET&#96; - Apple OAuth secret (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_TEAM_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth team ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_KEY_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth key ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY&#96; - Apple OAuth private key (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96; - Comma-separated admin emails\n- [ ] &#96;REDIS_URL&#96; - Redis connection (optional, for rate limiting)\n\n### Database\n- [ ] Production database created\n- [ ] Migration run: &#96;npx prisma migrate deploy&#96;\n- [ ] Prisma client generated: &#96;npx prisma generate&#96;\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] Database backups configured\n\n### Security\n- [ ] All secrets in environment variables (not in code)\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] CORS configured correctly\n- [ ] Rate limiting configured\n- [ ] CSRF protection enabled (Next.js default)\n\n### PWA\n- [ ] &#96;manifest.json&#96; updated with production URL\n- [ ] Icons generated (192x192, 512x512)\n- [ ] Service worker tested\n- [ ] Offline functionality tested\n\n## Deployment Steps\n\n### 1. Build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Test Build Locally\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Deploy\n- Deploy to your hosting platform (Vercel, Render, etc.)\n- Set all environment variables\n- Run database migrations\n\n### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works",

        "contents": "{\n  \"name\": \"voucher-platform\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"private\": true,\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"dev\": \"next dev\",\n    \"dev:clean\": \"node -e \\\"require('fs').rmSync('.next',{recursive:true,force:true})\\\" &amp;&amp; next dev\",\n    \"dev:all\": \"npm run dev:full\",\n    \"dev:full\": \"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/dev-full.ps1\",\n    \"build\": \"node scripts/build.cjs\",\n    \"build:next\": \"next build\",\n    \"start\": \"next start\",\n    \"lint\": \"next lint\",\n    \"docker:up\": \"docker compose up -d\",\n    \"docker:down\": \"docker compose down\",\n    \"docker:logs\": \"docker compose logs -f\",\n    \"db:check\": \"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-docker.ps1\",\n    \"db:wait\": \"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/wait-for-db.ps1\",\n    \"db:setup\": \"npm run db:check &amp;&amp; npm run docker:up &amp;&amp; timeout /t 5 /nobreak &gt;nul 2&gt;&amp;1 || node -e \\\"const d=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-d&lt;5000);\\\" &amp;&amp; npm run db:wait &amp;&amp; npm run db:push &amp;&amp; npm run db:seed\",\n    \"db:push\": \"prisma db push\",\n    \"db:migrate\": \"prisma migrate dev\",\n    \"db:seed\": \"tsx prisma/seed.ts\",\n    \"db:ensure-test-user\": \"tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts\",\n    \"db:studio\": \"prisma studio\",\n    \"test\": \"vitest\",\n    \"test:ui\": \"vitest --ui\",\n    \"test:e2e\": \"playwright test\",\n    \"test:e2e:ui\": \"playwright test --ui\",",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 61

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# Deployment Guide\n\n## Pre-Deployment Checklist\n\n- [ ] All environment variables configured\n- [ ] Database migrations run\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] SMTP configured for email magic links\n- [ ] OAuth providers configured (if using)\n- [ ] PWA icons generated (192x192 and 512x512 PNG)\n- [ ] Object storage configured (for brand assets)\n- [ ] Redis configured (for rate limiting in production)\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nRequired for production:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# App\nNODE_ENV=production\nNEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-domain.com\n\n# Database\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname\n\n# Redis (recommended for production caching and rate limiting)\nREDIS_URL=redis://host:6379\n\n# Error Tracking (Sentry - optional but recommended)\nNEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=https://your-sentry-dsn@sentry.io/project-id\n\n# Cron Jobs\nCRON_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars-for-cron-authentication&gt;\n\n# Auth\nAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\nNEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-domain.com\nNEXTAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\n\n# OAuth (optional)\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_ID=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_TEAM_ID=\nAPPLE_KEY_ID=\n\n# Email\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=noreply@your-domain.com\nSMTP_PASSWORD=\nSMTP_FROM=noreply@your-domain.com\n\n# Object Storage (S3 compatible)\nS3_ENDPOINT=\nS3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=\nS3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=\nS3_BUCKET=\nS3_REGION=\n\n# Platform Admin\nPLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@your-domain.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment Options\n\n### Vercel (Recommended)\n\n1. **Connect repository** to Vercel\n2. **Configure environment variables** in Vercel dashboard\n3. **Set build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Set output directory**: &#96;.next&#96;\n5. **Database**: Use Vercel Postgres or external provider\n6. **Redis**: Use Upstash Redis or external provider\n\n### Render\n\n1. **Create new Web Service**\n2. **Connect repository**\n3. **Build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Start command**: &#96;npm start&#96;\n5. **Environment**: Add all environment variables\n6. **Database**: Create PostgreSQL service",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport default function GlobalError({\n  error,\n  reset,\n}: {\n  error: Error &amp; { digest?: string };\n  reset: () =&gt; void;\n}) {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('Global error:', error);\n    }\n  }, [error]);\n\n  // Note: Global error cannot use next-intl hooks, so we use fallback text\n  // This is a critical error boundary that must work even if i18n fails\n  const errorStyles = &#96;\n    .ge-root { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }\n    .ge-h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n    .ge-p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 1rem; }\n    .ge-btn { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }\n  &#96;;\n  return (\n    &lt;html lang=\"en\"&gt;\n      &lt;head&gt;\n        &lt;style&gt;{errorStyles}&lt;/style&gt;\n      &lt;/head&gt;\n      &lt;body&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"ge-root\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"ge-h1\"&gt;Something went wrong&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"ge-p\"&gt;A critical error occurred. Kokkuvõte:

## Lõpetatud ülesanded

### 1. Testimise tööriistad
- Loodud `scripts/verify-mvp-setup.ts` — automaatne verifitseerimine
- Loodud `scripts/test-launch-mode.ts` — launch mode testid
- Lisatud npm skriptid: `npm run verify:setup` ja `npm run test:launch-mode`

### 2. Dokumentatsioon
- `docs/SETUP_VERIFICATION.md` — verifitseerimise juhend
- `docs/CONFIGURATION_GUIDE.md` — konfiguratsioonijuhend
- `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md` — implementatsiooni staatus

### 3. Verifitseerimine
- Kill switch kontrollid on API route'ides (voucher creation, publishing, redemptions)
- Kill switch kontrollid on avalikes lehtedel (`/v/[id]`, `/r/[id]`)
- Feature flags funktsioonid on implementeeritud
- Cron endpoint on olemas ja konfigureeritud
- PWA on seadistatud

## Kokkuvõte

Kood on valmis. Kõik MVP funktsioonid ja launch mode funktsioonid on implementeeritud. Järgmised sammud on konfigureerimine (mitte koodimuudatused):

1. Verifitseerimine: `npm run verify:setup`
2. Launch mode test: `npm run test:launch-mode`
3. Konfiguratsioon: vaata `docs/CONFIGURATION_GUIDE.md`
4. Migratsioonid: `npx prisma migrate deploy`

Kõik ülesanded on täidetud. Projekt on valmis testimiseks ja tootmiseks, kui on tehtud vajalikud konfiguratsioonid.

        "contents": "# Quick Start Guide\n\n## Ühe käsuga (soovitus) — &#96;dev:full&#96;\n\nKui Docker Desktop on käivitatud:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install\nnpm run dev:full\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee käivitab: Postgres, loob/värskendab &#96;.env.local&#96;, teeb &#96;db push&#96;, &#96;db:seed&#96; ja &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;, siis dev-serveri.\n\n**Testikasutaja:** &#96;test@example.com&#96; / &#96;test123&#96;  \n**Lehed:** &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt; → /app (Coffee House: Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard)\n\n---\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+ installed\n- Docker Desktop installed and running\n- Git (optional)\n\n## Setup Steps\n\n1. **Install dependencies**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Set up environment**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Copy the example env file\n   # Edit .env and set:\n   # - AUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - NEXTAUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - DATABASE_URL (already set for Docker)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Start database and initialize**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended)\n   npm run db:setup\n   \n   # Or manually:\n   npm run db:check      # Check Docker Desktop\n   npm run docker:up     # Start containers\n   npm run db:wait       # Wait for database\n   npm run db:push       # Push schema\n   npm run db:seed       # Seed data\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Start development server**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n5. **Open browser**:\n   Navigate to &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt;\n\n## Test the Flow\n\n1. **View a voucher** (after creating one):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&gt;\n   - Replace [voucherId] with an actual voucher ID from your database\n   - Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Login** (e‑post + parool):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt;\n   - [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) / **test123** (Credentials; töötab kohe kui &#96;dev:full&#96; või &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; on käivitatud)\n   - Või [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com) — magic link (vajab SMTP) või OAuth\n\n3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

        "contents": "# Troubleshooting Guide\n\n## Docker Desktop Issues\n\n### Problem: \"Docker Desktop is unable to start\"\n\n**Solution 1: Start Docker Desktop manually**\n1. Open Docker Desktop from Start Menu\n2. Wait for it to fully start (whale icon in system tray)\n3. Run &#96;npm run docker:up&#96; again\n\n**Solution 2: Restart Docker Desktop**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Stop Docker Desktop\nStop-Process -Name \"Docker Desktop\" -Force\n\n# Start Docker Desktop\nStart-Process \"${env:ProgramFiles}\\Docker\\Docker\\Docker Desktop.exe\"\n\n# Wait 30-60 seconds, then check\ndocker info\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Solution 3: Check WSL2 (Windows)**\nDocker Desktop requires WSL2 on Windows:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Check WSL version\nwsl --list --verbose\n\n# If WSL2 is not installed, install it:\nwsl --install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Solution 4: Restart Windows**\nSometimes Docker Desktop needs a system restart to work properly.\n\n### Problem: \"Can't reach database server at &#96;localhost:5432&#96;\"\n\n**Check if Docker containers are running:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ndocker ps\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**If containers are not running:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Start containers\nnpm run docker:up\n\n# Or manually\ndocker compose up -d\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Check container logs:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run docker:logs\n\n# Or manually\ndocker compose logs postgres\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Verify database connection:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Wait for database to be ready\nnpm run db:wait\n\n# Or check manually\nTest-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port 5432\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Database Setup\n\n### Quick Setup (Recommended)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# This will:\n# 1. Check Docker Desktop\n# 2. Start containers\n# 3. Wait for database\n# 4. Push schema\n# 5. Seed data\nnpm run db:setup\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Manual Setup\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Step 1: Check Docker\nnpm run db:check\n\n# Step 2: Start containers\nnpm run docker:up\n\n# Step 3: Wait for database\nnpm run db:wait\n\n# Step 4: Push schema\nnpm run db:push\n\n# Step 5: Seed data\nnpm run db:seed\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nMake sure &#96;.env&#96; file exists with:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nDATABASE_URL=\"postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db?schema=public\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Common Issues\n\n### Port 5432 already in use",

        "contents": "- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event\n\n### Tickets\n\n- &#96;POST /api/tickets/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Campaign&#96;: Campaign definitions (pricing, limits, credit percentages)\n- &#96;VoucherPurchase&#96;: Voucher purchase records\n- &#96;Event&#96;: Event definitions\n- &#96;Ticket&#96;: Ticket instances for events\n- &#96;TicketPurchase&#96;: Ticket purchase records\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances\n- &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records\n- &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions\n- &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records\n- &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail\n\nSee &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.\n\n## Business Rules\n\n1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn\n2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific\n3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)\n4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals\n5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation\n6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically\n7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced\n\n## Testing\n\nRun tests:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm test\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables",

        "contents": "# Full dev startup: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed/ensure-test-user, dev server\n# Run: npm run dev:full\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Continue\"\n$root = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot \"..\")).Path\nSet-Location $root\n\ndocker info 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] Docker ei käivitu. Käivita Docker Desktop ja proovi: npm run dev:full\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\n$localUrl = \"postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db\"\n$authSecret = \"voucher-dev-secret-min-32-chars-long\"\n$envLocalPath = Join-Path $root \".env.local\"\n\n# 1) .env.local (local Postgres + AUTH_SECRET, et Next.js ja auth töötaks)\n@\"\n# Local Docker Postgres (dev:full)\nDATABASE_URL=\"$localUrl\"\nAUTH_SECRET=\"$authSecret\"\n\"@ | Set-Content -Path $envLocalPath -Encoding utf8 -Force\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] .env.local ok\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n# 2) Docker Postgres\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Starting Postgres...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\ndocker compose up -d postgres 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Waiting for DB...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; \"$PSScriptRoot\\wait-for-db.ps1\" -MaxAttempts 30 -DelaySeconds 2\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] DB not ready. Check: docker compose logs postgres\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\n# 3) Prisma + seed (DATABASE_URL for Prisma CLI)\n$env:DATABASE_URL = $localUrl\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] prisma db push...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nnpx prisma db push\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] db:seed (may fail if data exists)...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; npm run db:seed 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] db:ensure-test-user...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; npm run db:ensure-test-user\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] ensure-test-user ebaõnnestus\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Test: test@example.com / test123\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Starting dev server...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nnpm run dev",

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;\n   - Fill in the form and create a voucher\n\n4. **Share voucher**:\n   - View the voucher at &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" (requires login)\n   - Copy the referral link\n\n5. **Redeem voucher**:\n   - Open referral link in incognito/private window\n   - Enter order amount and click \"Redeem Online\"\n\n6. **Confirm redemption** (as staff):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/redemptions&gt;\n   - Click \"Confirm Redemption\" on pending redemptions\n\n7. **View credit wallet**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/wallet&gt;\n   - See unlocked credit\n\n8. **Apply credit**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/checkout-demo&gt;\n   - Enter order amount and apply credit\n\n## Seed Data\n\nThe seed script creates:\n\n- 2 merchants (Coffee House, Tech Store)\n- 3 users: [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (parool: test123), [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com)\n- Sample vouchers, referrals, and credits\n\n&#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96; tagab [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) ja Coffee House liikmelisuse ka siis, kui seed on juba käivitatud.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n**Docker Desktop not starting**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:check&#96; to check Docker status\n- Start Docker Desktop manually from Start Menu\n- See [TROUBLESHOOTING.md][troubleshooting] for detailed solutions\n\n**Database connection error**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:wait&#96; to wait for database\n- Check Docker containers: &#96;npm run docker:logs&#96;\n- Ensure Docker is running: &#96;docker ps&#96;\n- Restart: &#96;npm run docker:down &amp;&amp; npm run docker:up&#96;\n\n**Port already in use**:\n\n- Change port in &#96;package.json&#96;: &#96;\"dev\": \"next dev -p 3001\"&#96;\n\n**Auth not working**:\n\n- Ensure AUTH_SECRET and NEXTAUTH_SECRET are set in .env\n- For email magic links, configure SMTP settings\n- For OAuth, add provider credentials\n\n**PWA icons missing**:",

        "contents": "5. **Environment**: Add all environment variables\n6. **Database**: Create PostgreSQL service\n7. **Redis**: Create Redis service (optional)\n\n### Fly.io\n\n1. **Install Fly CLI**: &#96;curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh&#96;\n2. **Login**: &#96;fly auth login&#96;\n3. **Launch**: &#96;fly launch&#96;\n4. **Set secrets**: &#96;fly secrets set KEY=value&#96;\n5. **Deploy**: &#96;fly deploy&#96;\n\n### Self-Hosted (Docker)\n\n1. **Build Docker image**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;dockerfile\n   FROM node:18-alpine\n   WORKDIR /app\n   COPY package*.json ./\n   RUN npm ci --only=production\n   COPY . .\n   RUN npm run build\n   CMD [\"npm\", \"start\"]\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Run with docker-compose**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n   services:\n     app:\n       build: .\n       ports:\n         - \"3000:3000\"\n       environment:\n         - DATABASE_URL=...\n         - NEXTAUTH_SECRET=...\n       depends_on:\n         - postgres\n         - redis\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Database Migrations\n\nIn production, use migrations instead of &#96;db:push&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run db:migrate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis creates a migration file that can be reviewed before applying.\n\n## Post-Deployment\n\n1. **Verify health**: Check &#96;/&#96; endpoint\n2. **Test authentication**: Try login flow\n3. **Test voucher creation**: Create a test voucher\n4. **Test redemption flow**: Complete end-to-end test\n5. **Monitor logs**: Check for errors\n6. **Set up monitoring**: Use Sentry, LogRocket, etc.\n\n## Scaling Considerations\n\n- **Database**: Use connection pooling (PgBouncer)\n- **Redis**: Use Redis Cluster for high availability\n- **CDN**: Use Vercel Edge Network or Cloudflare\n- **File Storage**: Use S3-compatible storage for brand assets\n- **Rate Limiting**: Configure Redis-based rate limiting\n- **Caching**: Cache public voucher pages\n\n## Security\n\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] Environment variables secured (never commit to git)\n- [ ] Database credentials rotated regularly\n- [ ] OAuth redirect URIs configured correctly\n- [ ] CORS configured (if needed)\n- [ ] Rate limiting enabled\n- [ ] Audit logging enabled\n\n## Backup Strategy",

        "contents": "# Deployment Checklist\n\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\n\n## Pre-Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables\n- [ ] &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\n- [ ] &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; - Random 32+ character string\n- [ ] &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_HOST&#96; - Email server for magic links\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PORT&#96; - Email server port\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_USER&#96; - Email server username\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&#96; - Email server password\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_FROM&#96; - From email address\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_API_KEY&#96; - Resend API key (recommended for transactional emails)\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_FROM_EMAIL&#96; - Default \"from\" address for Resend\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_SECRET_KEY&#96; - Stripe secret key (required for payments)\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET&#96; - Stripe webhook signing secret (required for webhooks)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY&#96; - Stripe publishable key (client-side)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth client ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_SECRET&#96; - Apple OAuth secret (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_TEAM_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth team ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_KEY_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth key ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY&#96; - Apple OAuth private key (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96; - Comma-separated admin emails\n- [ ] &#96;REDIS_URL&#96; - Redis connection (optional, for rate limiting)\n\n### Database\n- [ ] Production database created\n- [ ] Migration run: &#96;npx prisma migrate deploy&#96;\n- [ ] Prisma client generated: &#96;npx prisma generate&#96;\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] Database backups configured\n\n### Security\n- [ ] All secrets in environment variables (not in code)\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] CORS configured correctly\n- [ ] Rate limiting configured\n- [ ] CSRF protection enabled (Next.js default)\n\n### PWA\n- [ ] &#96;manifest.json&#96; updated with production URL\n- [ ] Icons generated (192x192, 512x512)\n- [ ] Service worker tested\n- [ ] Offline functionality tested\n\n## Deployment Steps\n\n### 1. Build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Test Build Locally\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Deploy\n- Deploy to your hosting platform (Vercel, Render, etc.)\n- Set all environment variables\n- Run database migrations\n\n### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works",

        "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works\n- [ ] Magic link emails sent\n- [ ] OAuth providers work (if configured)\n- [ ] Voucher pages load\n- [ ] Referral pages load\n- [ ] PWA installable\n- [ ] Service worker active\n\n#### Test Core Flows\n- [ ] Create voucher\n- [ ] Create campaign\n- [ ] Generate vouchers from campaign\n- [ ] Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- [ ] Publish voucher\n- [ ] Share referral\n- [ ] Redeem voucher\n- [ ] Confirm redemption\n- [ ] Credit unlocks\n- [ ] Apply credit\n- [ ] Create event\n- [ ] Generate tickets for event\n- [ ] Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n#### Monitor\n- [ ] Error logs checked\n- [ ] Performance metrics reviewed\n- [ ] Database connections stable\n- [ ] API response times acceptable\n\n## Launch Mode Setup\n\n### Initial Setup\n- [ ] Run launch mode migration\n- [ ] Create first merchant via database\n- [ ] Add merchant admin user\n- [ ] Test merchant dashboard access\n- [ ] Verify kill switch works\n\n### Merchant Onboarding\n- [ ] Document onboarding process\n- [ ] Create merchant invite template\n- [ ] Set up merchant creation workflow\n- [ ] Test feature flags\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Set Up\n- [ ] Error tracking (Sentry, etc.)\n- [ ] Performance monitoring\n- [ ] Database monitoring\n- [ ] Uptime monitoring\n- [ ] Log aggregation\n\n### Alerts\n- [ ] Database connection failures\n- [ ] High error rates\n- [ ] Slow API responses\n- [ ] Merchant deactivations\n- [ ] Unusual redemption patterns\n\n## Rollback Plan\n\n### If Issues Occur\n1. **Immediate**: Deactivate problematic merchants via kill switch\n2. **Short-term**: Revert deployment if critical bug\n3. **Long-term**: Fix issue and redeploy\n\n### Rollback Steps\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Revert code deployment\n# 2. Check database migrations (may need to rollback)\n# 3. Verify environment variables\n# 4.
