        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\DEPLOYMENT.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

            "line": 84

        },
        "contents": "# Deployment Guide\n\n## Pre-Deployment Checklist\n\n- [ ] All environment variables configured\n- [ ] Database migrations run\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] SMTP configured for email magic links\n- [ ] OAuth providers configured (if using)\n- [ ] PWA icons generated (192x192 and 512x512 PNG)\n- [ ] Object storage configured (for brand assets)\n- [ ] Redis configured (for rate limiting in production)\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nRequired for production:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# App\nNODE_ENV=production\nNEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-domain.com\n\n# Database\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname\n\n# Redis (recommended for production caching and rate limiting)\nREDIS_URL=redis://host:6379\n\n# Error Tracking (Sentry - optional but recommended)\nNEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=https://your-sentry-dsn@sentry.io/project-id\n\n# Cron Jobs\nCRON_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars-for-cron-authentication&gt;\n\n# Auth\nAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\nNEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-domain.com\nNEXTAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\n\n# OAuth (optional)\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_ID=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_TEAM_ID=\nAPPLE_KEY_ID=\n\n# Email\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=noreply@your-domain.com\nSMTP_PASSWORD=\nSMTP_FROM=noreply@your-domain.com\n\n# Object Storage (S3 compatible)\nS3_ENDPOINT=\nS3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=\nS3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=\nS3_BUCKET=\nS3_REGION=\n\n# Platform Admin\nPLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@your-domain.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment Options\n\n### Vercel (Recommended)\n\n1. **Connect repository** to Vercel\n2. **Configure environment variables** in Vercel dashboard\n3. **Set build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Set output directory**: &#96;.next&#96;\n5. **Database**: Use Vercel Postgres or external provider\n6. **Redis**: Use Upstash Redis or external provider\n\n### Render\n\n1. **Create new Web Service**\n2. **Connect repository**\n3. **Build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Start command**: &#96;npm start&#96;\n5. **Environment**: Add all environment variables\n6. **Database**: Create PostgreSQL service",

        "contents": "# PowerShell script to check and start Docker Desktop\nparam(\n    [int]$MaxWaitSeconds = 120,\n    [int]$CheckIntervalSeconds = 3\n)\n\nWrite-Host \"Checking Docker Desktop status...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n\n# Function to check if Docker is ready\nfunction Test-DockerReady {\n    docker info 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\n    return $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0\n}\n\n# Check if Docker Desktop is already running\nif (Test-DockerReady) {\n    Write-Host \"✅ Docker Desktop is running\" -ForegroundColor Green\n    exit 0\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"❌ Docker Desktop is not running\" -ForegroundColor Red\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Try to start Docker Desktop\n$dockerPath = \"${env:ProgramFiles}\\Docker\\Docker\\Docker Desktop.exe\"\nif (-not (Test-Path $dockerPath)) {\n    Write-Host \"Docker Desktop not found at: $dockerPath\" -ForegroundColor Red\n    Write-Host \"Please install Docker Desktop from: https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n    exit 1\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"Attempting to start Docker Desktop...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nStart-Process $dockerPath\n\n# Wait for Docker Desktop to start\nWrite-Host \"Waiting for Docker Desktop to start (this may take 30-60 seconds)...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n$elapsed = 0\n$startTime = Get-Date\n\nwhile ($elapsed -lt $MaxWaitSeconds) {\n    Start-Sleep -Seconds $CheckIntervalSeconds\n    $elapsed = ((Get-Date) - $startTime).TotalSeconds\n    \n    if (Test-DockerReady) {\n        Write-Host \"✅ Docker Desktop is now running!\" -ForegroundColor Green\n        # Give it a few more seconds to fully initialize\n        Start-Sleep -Seconds 5\n        exit 0\n    }\n    \n    $remaining = [math]::Max(0, $MaxWaitSeconds - $elapsed)\n    Write-Host \"  Still waiting... (${remaining}s remaining)\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"❌ Docker Desktop did not start within ${MaxWaitSeconds} seconds\" -ForegroundColor Red\nWrite-Host \"Please:\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  1.         "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise staatus\n\n## ✅ Valmis\n\n1. **i18n konfiguratsioon**\n   - ✅ 5 keelt: en, et, es, fr, de\n   - ✅ Routing konfiguratsioon\n   - ✅ Middleware locale detection'iga\n\n2. **Tõlked**\n   - ✅ Inglise (en) - täielik\n   - ✅ Eesti (et) - täielik\n   - ✅ Hispaania (es) - täielik\n   - ✅ Prantsuse (fr) - täielik\n   - ✅ Saksa (de) - täielik\n\n3. **Komponendid**\n   - ✅ Language selector\n   - ✅ Locale-aware layout\n   - ✅ i18n utilities (valuuta, kuupäevad)\n\n4. **Dokumentatsioon**\n   - ✅ I18N_GUIDE.md - täielik juhend\n\n## ⚠️ Vajab täiendamist\n\n### 1. Olemasolevate lehtede migreerimine\n\nPraegu on palju lehti, mis ei kasuta tõlkeid. Need tuleb järk-järgult migreerida:\n\n**Prioriteet 1 (kõrge):**\n- &#96;app/login/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 2 (keskmine):**\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/dashboard/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet/page.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 3 (madal):**\n- Kõik ülejäänud lehed\n\n### 2.         "contents": "# How to Add a New Locale\n\nThe platform uses &#96;next-intl&#96; for internationalization. Currently, English (&#96;en&#96;) is the default locale.\n\n## Adding a New Locale\n\n1. **Add locale to configuration**:\n   Edit &#96;i18n.ts&#96; and add your locale to the &#96;locales&#96; array:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   export const locales = ['en', 'es', 'fr'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Create translation file**:\n   Create &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; (e.g., &#96;messages/es.json&#96;) with translations:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n   {\n     \"common\": {\n       \"welcome\": \"Bienvenido\",\n       \"loading\": \"Cargando...\",\n       \"error\": \"Error\",\n       \"success\": \"Éxito\"\n     },\n     \"voucher\": {\n       \"share\": \"Compartir Cupón\",\n       \"redeem\": \"Canjear\",\n       \"expired\": \"Expirado\"\n     }\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Update middleware** (if needed):\n   The middleware can detect locale from headers or URL segments. Update &#96;middleware.ts&#96; if you want locale-based routing.\n\n4. **Use translations in components**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n   \n   function MyComponent() {\n     const t = useTranslations('common');\n     return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Locale Detection\n\nThe platform can detect locale from:\n- URL path prefix (e.g., &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;)\n- Accept-Language header\n- User preference (stored in session)\n\n## Currency Formatting\n\nCurrency formatting is handled by &#96;formatCurrency&#96; in &#96;lib/utils.ts&#96;, which uses &#96;Intl.NumberFormat&#96;. The currency code comes from the merchant's &#96;defaultCurrency&#96; field.",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise juhend\n\n## Toetatud keeled\n\nPlatvorm toetab praegu järgmisi keeli:\n- **en** - English (inglise)\n- **et** - Eesti (eesti)\n- **es** - Español (hispaania)\n- **fr** - Français (prantsuse)\n- **de** - Deutsch (saksa)\n\n## Kuidas see töötab\n\n### 1. URL struktuur\n\n- Inglise (vaikimisi): &#96;/v/[id]&#96; või &#96;/en/v/[id]&#96;\n- Eesti: &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96;\n- Hispaania: &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;\n- jne.\n\n### 2. Keele valik\n\nKeele valija on kõikjal lehe ülaosas paremal. Kasutaja saab valida keele, mis rakendatakse kogu platvormile.\n\n### 3. Tõlked\n\nKõik tõlked on &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; failides. Struktuur on järgmine:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"common\": { ... },\n  \"voucher\": { ... },\n  \"merchant\": { ... },\n  \"wallet\": { ... },\n  ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kuidas kasutada tõlkeid\n\n### Server Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyPage() {\n  const t = useTranslations('common');\n  return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Client Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n'use client';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyComponent() {\n  const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n  return &lt;button&gt;{t('share')}&lt;/button&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Linkide kasutamine\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Link } from '@/routing';\n\n&lt;Link href=\"/vouchers\"&gt;Vouchers&lt;/Link&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee tagab, et link säilitab praeguse keele.\n\n## Uue keele lisamine\n\n1. **Lisa keel konfiguratsiooni**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // i18n.ts\n   export const locales = ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Lisa keel routing'usse**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // routing.ts\n   locales: ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi']\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Loo tõlke fail**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp messages/en.json messages/fi.json\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Tõlgi kõik stringid** &#96;messages/fi.json&#96; failis.\n\n5. **Lisa keele nimi**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis - 13 keelt!\n\nPlatvorm toetab nüüd **13 keelt**:\n\n1. **en** - English (Inglise) - vaikimisi\n2. **et** - Eesti (Eesti)\n3. **es** - Español (Hispaania)\n4. **fr** - Français (Prantsuse)\n5. **de** - Deutsch (Saksa)\n6. **fi** - Suomi (Soome) ⭐ UUS\n7. **sv** - Svenska (Rootsi) ⭐ UUS\n8. **no** - Norsk (Norra) ⭐ UUS\n9. **da** - Dansk (Taani) ⭐ UUS\n10. **lv** - Latviešu (Läti) ⭐ UUS\n11. **lt** - Lietuvių (Leedu) ⭐ UUS\n12. **pl** - Polski (Poola) ⭐ UUS\n13. **uk** - Українська (Ukraina) ⭐ UUS\n\n## 📁 Failid\n\nKõik tõlke failid on &#96;messages/&#96; kaustas:\n- &#96;messages/en.json&#96; - Inglise (vaikimisi)\n- &#96;messages/et.json&#96; - Eesti\n- &#96;messages/es.json&#96; - Hispaania\n- &#96;messages/fr.json&#96; - Prantsuse\n- &#96;messages/de.json&#96; - Saksa\n- &#96;messages/fi.json&#96; - Soome ⭐\n- &#96;messages/sv.json&#96; - Rootsi ⭐\n- &#96;messages/no.json&#96; - Norra ⭐\n- &#96;messages/da.json&#96; - Taani ⭐\n- &#96;messages/lv.json&#96; - Läti ⭐\n- &#96;messages/lt.json&#96; - routing konfiguratsioon\n- ✅ &#96;middleware.ts&#96; - URL matcher\n- ✅ &#96;components/language-selector.tsx&#96; - keele nimed\n- ✅ &#96;lib/i18n-utils.ts&#96; - valuuta locale mapping\n\n## 🌍 URL struktuur\n\nKõik keeled on saadaval URL-is:\n- &#96;/v/[id]&#96; - Inglise (vaikimisi)\n- &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96; - Eesti\n- &#96;/fi/v/[id]&#96; - Soome\n- &#96;/sv/v/[id]&#96; - Rootsi\n- &#96;/no/v/[id]&#96; - Norra\n- &#96;/da/v/[id]&#96; - Taani\n- &#96;/lv/v/[id]&#96;         "contents": "import NextAuth from 'next-auth';\nimport { PrismaAdapter } from '@auth/prisma-adapter';\nimport EmailProvider from 'next-auth/providers/email';\nimport GoogleProvider from 'next-auth/providers/google';\nimport AppleProvider from 'next-auth/providers/apple';\nimport FacebookProvider from 'next-auth/providers/facebook';\nimport GitHubProvider from 'next-auth/providers/github';\nimport TwitterProvider from 'next-auth/providers/twitter';\nimport LinkedInProvider from 'next-auth/providers/linkedin';\nimport Credentials from 'next-auth/providers/credentials';\nimport { prisma } from './prisma';\n\nconst testEmail = process.env.TEST_USER_EMAIL ?? (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? 'test@example.com' : '');\nconst testPassword = process.env.TEST_USER_PASSWORD ?? (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? 'test123' : '');\n\nexport const { handlers, auth, signIn, signOut } = NextAuth({\n  adapter: PrismaAdapter(prisma),\n  providers: [\n    Credentials({\n      credentials: {\n        email: { label: 'Email', type: 'email' },\n        password: { label: 'Password', type: 'password' },\n      },\n      async authorize(credentials) {\n        if (!credentials?.email || typeof credentials.email !== 'string' || !credentials?.password || typeof credentials.password !== 'string') return null;\n        if (!testEmail || !testPassword) return null;\n        if (credentials.email !== testEmail || credentials.password !== testPassword) return null;\n        let user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: testEmail } });\n        if (!user) {\n          user = await prisma.user.create({ data: { email: testEmail, name: 'Test User' } });\n        }\n        return { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name ?? 'Test User' };\n      },\n    }),\n    EmailProvider({\n      server: {\n        host: process.env.SMTP_HOST,\n        port: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT) || 587,\n        auth: {\n          user: process.env.SMTP_USER,\n          pass: process.env.SMTP_PASSWORD,\n        },\n        from: process.env.SMTP_FROM || 'noreply@voucher-platform.com'\n\n;",

        "contents": "# Deployment Guide\n\n## Pre-Deployment Checklist\n\n- [ ] All environment variables configured\n- [ ] Database migrations run\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] SMTP configured for email magic links\n- [ ] OAuth providers configured (if using)\n- [ ] PWA icons generated (192x192 and 512x512 PNG)\n- [ ] Object storage configured (for brand assets)\n- [ ] Redis configured (for rate limiting in production)\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nRequired for production:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# App\nNODE_ENV=production\nNEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-domain.com\n\n# Database\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname\n\n# Redis (recommended for production caching and rate limiting)\nREDIS_URL=redis://host:6379\n\n# Error Tracking (Sentry - optional but recommended)\nNEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=https://your-sentry-dsn@sentry.io/project-id\n\n# Cron Jobs\nCRON_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars-for-cron-authentication&gt;\n\n# Auth\nAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\nNEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-domain.com\nNEXTAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\n\n# OAuth (optional)\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_ID=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_TEAM_ID=\nAPPLE_KEY_ID=\n\n# Email\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=noreply@your-domain.com\nSMTP_PASSWORD=\nSMTP_FROM=noreply@your-domain.com\n\n# Object Storage (S3 compatible)\nS3_ENDPOINT=\nS3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=\nS3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=\nS3_BUCKET=\nS3_REGION=\n\n# Platform Admin\nPLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@your-domain.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment Options\n\n### Vercel (Recommended)\n\n1. **Connect repository** to Vercel\n2. **Configure environment variables** in Vercel dashboard\n3. **Set build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Set output directory**: &#96;.next&#96;\n5. **Database**: Use Vercel Postgres or external provider\n6. **Redis**: Use Upstash Redis or external provider\n\n### Render\n\n1. **Create new Web Service**\n2. **Connect repository**\n3. **Build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Start command**: &#96;npm start&#96;\n5. **Environment**: Add all environment variables\n6. **Database**: Create PostgreSQL service",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise staatus\n\n## ✅ Valmis\n\n1. **i18n konfiguratsioon**\n   - ✅ 5 keelt: en, et, es, fr, de\n   - ✅ Routing konfiguratsioon\n   - ✅ Middleware locale detection'iga\n\n2. **Tõlked**\n   - ✅ Inglise (en) - täielik\n   - ✅ Eesti (et) - täielik\n   - ✅ Hispaania (es) - täielik\n   - ✅ Prantsuse (fr) - täielik\n   - ✅ Saksa (de) - täielik\n\n3. **Komponendid**\n   - ✅ Language selector\n   - ✅ Locale-aware layout\n   - ✅ i18n utilities (valuuta, kuupäevad)\n\n4. **Dokumentatsioon**\n   - ✅ I18N_GUIDE.md - täielik juhend\n\n## ⚠️ Vajab täiendamist\n\n### 1. Olemasolevate lehtede migreerimine\n\nPraegu on palju lehti, mis ei kasuta tõlkeid. Need tuleb järk-järgult migreerida:\n\n**Prioriteet 1 (kõrge):**\n- &#96;app/login/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 2 (keskmine):**\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/dashboard/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet/page.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 3 (madal):**\n- Kõik ülejäänud lehed\n\n### 2.         "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise juhend\n\n## Toetatud keeled\n\nPlatvorm toetab praegu järgmisi keeli:\n- **en** - English (inglise)\n- **et** - Eesti (eesti)\n- **es** - Español (hispaania)\n- **fr** - Français (prantsuse)\n- **de** - Deutsch (saksa)\n\n## Kuidas see töötab\n\n### 1. URL struktuur\n\n- Inglise (vaikimisi): &#96;/v/[id]&#96; või &#96;/en/v/[id]&#96;\n- Eesti: &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96;\n- Hispaania: &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;\n- jne.\n\n### 2. Keele valik\n\nKeele valija on kõikjal lehe ülaosas paremal. Kasutaja saab valida keele, mis rakendatakse kogu platvormile.\n\n### 3. Tõlked\n\nKõik tõlked on &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; failides. Struktuur on järgmine:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"common\": { ... },\n  \"voucher\": { ... },\n  \"merchant\": { ... },\n  \"wallet\": { ... },\n  ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kuidas kasutada tõlkeid\n\n### Server Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyPage() {\n  const t = useTranslations('common');\n  return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Client Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n'use client';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyComponent() {\n  const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n  return &lt;button&gt;{t('share')}&lt;/button&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Linkide kasutamine\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Link } from '@/routing';\n\n&lt;Link href=\"/vouchers\"&gt;Vouchers&lt;/Link&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee tagab, et link säilitab praeguse keele.\n\n## Uue keele lisamine\n\n1. **Lisa keel konfiguratsiooni**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // i18n.ts\n   export const locales = ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Lisa keel routing'usse**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // routing.ts\n   locales: ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi']\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Loo tõlke fail**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp messages/en.json messages/fi.json\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Tõlgi kõik stringid** &#96;messages/fi.json&#96; failis.\n\n5. **Lisa keele nimi**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\I18N.md",
        "range": {

            "line": 53
          }
        },
        "contents": "# How to Add a New Locale\n\nThe platform uses &#96;next-intl&#96; for internationalization. Currently, English (&#96;en&#96;) is the default locale.\n\n## Adding a New Locale\n\n1. **Add locale to configuration**:\n   Edit &#96;i18n.ts&#96; and add your locale to the &#96;locales&#96; array:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   export const locales = ['en', 'es', 'fr'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Create translation file**:\n   Create &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; (e.g., &#96;messages/es.json&#96;) with translations:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n   {\n     \"common\": {\n       \"welcome\": \"Bienvenido\",\n       \"loading\": \"Cargando...\",\n       \"error\": \"Error\",\n       \"success\": \"Éxito\"\n     },\n     \"voucher\": {\n       \"share\": \"Compartir Cupón\",\n       \"redeem\": \"Canjear\",\n       \"expired\": \"Expirado\"\n     }\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Update middleware** (if needed):\n   The middleware can detect locale from headers or URL segments. Update &#96;middleware.ts&#96; if you want locale-based routing.\n\n4. **Use translations in components**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n   \n   function MyComponent() {\n     const t = useTranslations('common');\n     return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Locale Detection\n\nThe platform can detect locale from:\n- URL path prefix (e.g., &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;)\n- Accept-Language header\n- User preference (stored in session)\n\n## Currency Formatting\n\nCurrency formatting is handled by &#96;formatCurrency&#96; in &#96;lib/utils.ts&#96;, which uses &#96;Intl.NumberFormat&#96;. The currency code comes from the merchant's &#96;defaultCurrency&#96; field.",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport default function GlobalError({\n  error,\n  reset,\n}: {\n  error: Error &amp; { digest?: string };\n  reset: () =&gt; void;\n}) {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('Global error:', error);\n    }\n  }, [error]);\n\n  // Note: Global error cannot use next-intl hooks, so we use fallback text\n  // This is a critical error boundary that must work even if i18n fails\n  const errorStyles = &#96;\n    .ge-root { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }\n    .ge-h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n    .ge-p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 1rem; }\n    .ge-btn { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }\n  &#96;;\n  return (\n    &lt;html lang=\"en\"&gt;\n      &lt;head&gt;\n        &lt;style&gt;{errorStyles}&lt;/style&gt;\n      &lt;/head&gt;\n      &lt;body&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"ge-root\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"ge-h1\"&gt;Something went wrong&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"ge-p\"&gt;A critical error occurred.         "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications System\n- ✅ Radix UI toast komponendid\n- ✅ Success, error, info variandid\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n- ✅ Helper funktsioonid (&#96;showSuccess&#96;, &#96;showError&#96;, &#96;showInfo&#96;)\n- ✅ Integreeritud root layout'is\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent spinner'iga\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; komponent loading state'ide jaoks\n- ✅ Näide kasutamisest &#96;publish-button.tsx&#96;'is\n\n### 3. Analytics Dashboard\n- ✅ Uus analytics leht (&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;)\n- ✅ Total redemptions, revenue, credits issued\n- ✅ Top vouchers statistika\n- ✅ Recent redemptions list\n- ✅ Link dashboard'ist\n\n### 4. UI Komponendid\n- ✅ &#96;Select&#96; komponent (Radix UI)\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; loading komponent\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent\n- ✅ &#96;Toast&#96; süsteem\n\n## 📋 Järgmised sammud (valikuline)\n\n### Prioriteet 1\n1. **Asendada kõik alert() kutsed toast'idega**\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n\n2. **Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine**\n   - Otsing välja\n   - Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n   - Sortimine\n\n3. **Parem error handling UI**\n   - Error boundaries\n   - Retry mechanisms\n\n### Prioriteet 2\n4. **Email notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n\n5. **Voucher mallid**\n   - Eeldefineeritud mallid\n   - Mallide salvestamine\n   - Kiire loomine\n\n6. **Export funktsioonid**\n   - CSV export redemptions\n   - Credits ledger export\n\n### Prioriteet 3\n7. **Graafikud ja visualisatsioonid**\n   - Chart.js või Recharts integratsioon\n   - Time-series graafikud\n   - Conversion funnels\n\n8. **Bulk operations**\n   - Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport default function GlobalError({\n  error,\n  reset,\n}: {\n  error: Error &amp; { digest?: string };\n  reset: () =&gt; void;\n}) {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('Global error:', error);\n    }\n  }, [error]);\n\n  // Note: Global error cannot use next-intl hooks, so we use fallback text\n  // This is a critical error boundary that must work even if i18n fails\n  const errorStyles = &#96;\n    .ge-root { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }\n    .ge-h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n    .ge-p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 1rem; }\n    .ge-btn { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }\n  &#96;;\n  return (\n    &lt;html lang=\"en\"&gt;\n      &lt;head&gt;\n        &lt;style&gt;{errorStyles}&lt;/style&gt;\n      &lt;/head&gt;\n      &lt;body&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"ge-root\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"ge-h1\"&gt;Something went wrong&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"ge-p\"&gt;A critical error occurred.         "contents": "# V2 Backlog\n\n**DO NOT BUILD** - These features are explicitly forbidden in MVP and should only be documented for future consideration.\n\n## Forbidden Features (Per Specification)\n\n### Marketplace &amp; Discovery\n- ❌ Public marketplace/feed of vouchers\n- ❌ Deals feed\n- ❌ Ad network\n- ❌ Social platform features\n\n### Social Features\n- ❌ Comments on vouchers\n- ❌ Likes/reactions\n- ❌ Social sharing beyond native share sheet\n- ❌ User profiles/public pages\n\n### Loyalty &amp; Tiers\n- ❌ Loyalty tiers/levels\n- ❌ Points systems\n- ❌ Gamification\n\n### AI Features\n- ❌ AI-powered recommendations\n- ❌ AI-generated voucher designs\n- ❌ AI content generation\n\n### Advertising\n- ❌ Ad placements\n- ❌ Sponsored vouchers\n- ❌ Third-party advertising\n\n### Influencer Features\n- ❌ Influencer dashboards\n- ❌ Influencer-specific tools\n- ❌ Creator monetization\n\n## Potential V2 Features (Document Only)\n\nThese were mentioned in the specification as V2 backlog items:\n\n1. **Apple Wallet / Google Wallet**\n   - Add vouchers to native wallet apps\n   - QR codes in wallet format\n\n2. **Push Notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n   - Credit expiry warnings\n\n3. **Multi-language Selector**\n   - User-selectable language (beyond browser detection)\n   - Language preferences per user\n\n4. **Custom Domains**\n   - Merchant-branded domains\n   - White-label subdomains\n\n5. **POS Deep Integrations**\n   - Direct POS system integration\n   - Real-time inventory sync\n   - Automated redemption confirmation\n\n6. **Analytics Exports**\n   - PDF reports\n   - CSV exports (already have for redemptions)\n   - Scheduled reports\n\n7. **White-label Mode**\n   - Fully branded merchant experience\n   - Remove platform branding\n   - Custom email templates\n\n## Current Non-MVP Pages (For Reference)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in MVP scope:\n\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Platform admin (internal use for launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - Analytics dashboard (V2)",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;         "contents": "interface VoucherClientProps {\n;\n  voucherCode: string;\n  qrCodeDataUrl: string;\n  isAuthenticated: boolean;\n  campaign?: any;\n}\n\nexport default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n  const [isPurchasing, setIsPurchasing] = useState(false);\n  const t = useTranslations('payment');\n  const tVoucher = useTranslations('voucher');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const tSuccess = useTranslations('success');\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n  \n  const hasPrice = campaign?.price !== null &amp;&amp; campaign?.price !== undefined;\n  const price = campaign?.price || 0;\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess(t('codeCopied'));\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handlePurchase = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!isAuthenticated) {\n      window.location.href = &#96;/login?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.href)}&#96;;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsPurchasing(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/vouchers/${voucher.id}/purchase&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({}),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const error = await res.json();\n        throw new Error(error.error || t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      if (data.url) {\n        window.location.href = data.url;\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t('purchaseFailed'));\n      setIsPurchasing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function VoucherPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: { \n      merchant: true,\n      campaign: true,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!voucher || voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const voucherUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/v/${voucher.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(voucherUrl);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;VoucherClient\n      voucher={voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n}",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications System\n- ✅ Radix UI toast komponendid\n- ✅ Success, error, info variandid\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n- ✅ Helper funktsioonid (&#96;showSuccess&#96;, &#96;showError&#96;, &#96;showInfo&#96;)\n- ✅ Integreeritud root layout'is\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent spinner'iga\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; komponent loading state'ide jaoks\n- ✅ Näide kasutamisest &#96;publish-button.tsx&#96;'is\n\n### 3. Analytics Dashboard\n- ✅ Uus analytics leht (&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;)\n- ✅ Total redemptions, revenue, credits issued\n- ✅ Top vouchers statistika\n- ✅ Recent redemptions list\n- ✅ Link dashboard'ist\n\n### 4. UI Komponendid\n- ✅ &#96;Select&#96; komponent (Radix UI)\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; loading komponent\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent\n- ✅ &#96;Toast&#96; süsteem\n\n## 📋 Järgmised sammud (valikuline)\n\n### Prioriteet 1\n1. **Asendada kõik alert() kutsed toast'idega**\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n\n2. **Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine**\n   - Otsing välja\n   - Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n   - Sortimine\n\n3. **Parem error handling UI**\n   - Error boundaries\n   - Retry mechanisms\n\n### Prioriteet 2\n4. **Email notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n\n5. **Voucher mallid**\n   - Eeldefineeritud mallid\n   - Mallide salvestamine\n   - Kiire loomine\n\n6. **Export funktsioonid**\n   - CSV export redemptions\n   - Credits ledger export\n\n### Prioriteet 3\n7. **Graafikud ja visualisatsioonid**\n   - Chart.js või Recharts integratsioon\n   - Time-series graafikud\n   - Conversion funnels\n\n8. **Bulk operations**\n   - Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## ✅ Valmis täiustused",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Toast Notifications System",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Radix UI toast komponendid",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Success, error, info variandid",
            "lineNumber": 7

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n      isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}\n    /&gt;\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError(tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn'));\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('showQrToStaff'));\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('discountApplied', { amount: formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency) }));\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "# How to Add a New Locale\n\nThe platform uses &#96;next-intl&#96; for internationalization. Currently, English (&#96;en&#96;) is the default locale.\n\n## Adding a New Locale\n\n1. **Add locale to configuration**:\n   Edit &#96;i18n.ts&#96; and add your locale to the &#96;locales&#96; array:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   export const locales = ['en', 'es', 'fr'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Create translation file**:\n   Create &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; (e.g., &#96;messages/es.json&#96;) with translations:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n   {\n     \"common\": {\n       \"welcome\": \"Bienvenido\",\n       \"loading\": \"Cargando...\",\n       \"error\": \"Error\",\n       \"success\": \"Éxito\"\n     },\n     \"voucher\": {\n       \"share\": \"Compartir Cupón\",\n       \"redeem\": \"Canjear\",\n       \"expired\": \"Expirado\"\n     }\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Update middleware** (if needed):\n   The middleware can detect locale from headers or URL segments. Update &#96;middleware.ts&#96; if you want locale-based routing.\n\n4. **Use translations in components**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n   \n   function MyComponent() {\n     const t = useTranslations('common');\n     return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Locale Detection\n\nThe platform can detect locale from:\n- URL path prefix (e.g., &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;)\n- Accept-Language header\n- User preference (stored in session)\n\n## Currency Formatting\n\nCurrency formatting is handled by &#96;formatCurrency&#96; in &#96;lib/utils.ts&#96;, which uses &#96;Intl.NumberFormat&#96;. The currency code comes from the merchant's &#96;defaultCurrency&#96; field.",

            "line": 96
          }

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise juhend\n\n## Toetatud keeled\n\nPlatvorm toetab praegu järgmisi keeli:\n- **en** - English (inglise)\n- **et** - Eesti (eesti)\n- **es** - Español (hispaania)\n- **fr** - Français (prantsuse)\n- **de** - Deutsch (saksa)\n\n## Kuidas see töötab\n\n### 1. URL struktuur\n\n- Inglise (vaikimisi): &#96;/v/[id]&#96; või &#96;/en/v/[id]&#96;\n- Eesti: &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96;\n- Hispaania: &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;\n- jne.\n\n### 2. Keele valik\n\nKeele valija on kõikjal lehe ülaosas paremal. Kasutaja saab valida keele, mis rakendatakse kogu platvormile.\n\n### 3. Tõlked\n\nKõik tõlked on &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; failides. Struktuur on järgmine:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"common\": { ... },\n  \"voucher\": { ... },\n  \"merchant\": { ... },\n  \"wallet\": { ... },\n  ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kuidas kasutada tõlkeid\n\n### Server Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyPage() {\n  const t = useTranslations('common');\n  return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Client Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n'use client';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyComponent() {\n  const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n  return &lt;button&gt;{t('share')}&lt;/button&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Linkide kasutamine\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Link } from '@/routing';\n\n&lt;Link href=\"/vouchers\"&gt;Vouchers&lt;/Link&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee tagab, et link säilitab praeguse keele.\n\n## Uue keele lisamine\n\n1. **Lisa keel konfiguratsiooni**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // i18n.ts\n   export const locales = ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Lisa keel routing'usse**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // routing.ts\n   locales: ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi']\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Loo tõlke fail**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp messages/en.json messages/fi.json\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Tõlgi kõik stringid** &#96;messages/fi.json&#96; failis.\n\n5. **Lisa keele nimi**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport default function GlobalError({\n  error,\n  reset,\n}: {\n  error: Error &amp; { digest?: string };\n  reset: () =&gt; void;\n}) {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('Global error:', error);\n    }\n  }, [error]);\n\n  // Note: Global error cannot use next-intl hooks, so we use fallback text\n  // This is a critical error boundary that must work even if i18n fails\n  const errorStyles = &#96;\n    .ge-root { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }\n    .ge-h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n    .ge-p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 1rem; }\n    .ge-btn { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }\n  &#96;;\n  return (\n    &lt;html lang=\"en\"&gt;\n      &lt;head&gt;\n        &lt;style&gt;{errorStyles}&lt;/style&gt;\n      &lt;/head&gt;\n      &lt;body&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"ge-root\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"ge-h1\"&gt;Something went wrong&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"ge-p\"&gt;A critical error occurred. NextIntlClientProvider is only available\n  // within app/[locale]/layout.tsx.         "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications System\n- ✅ Radix UI toast komponendid\n- ✅ Success, error, info variandid\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n- ✅ Helper funktsioonid (&#96;showSuccess&#96;, &#96;showError&#96;, &#96;showInfo&#96;)\n- ✅ Integreeritud root layout'is\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent spinner'iga\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; komponent loading state'ide jaoks\n- ✅ Näide kasutamisest &#96;publish-button.tsx&#96;'is\n\n### 3. Analytics Dashboard\n- ✅ Uus analytics leht (&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;)\n- ✅ Total redemptions, revenue, credits issued\n- ✅ Top vouchers statistika\n- ✅ Recent redemptions list\n- ✅ Link dashboard'ist\n\n### 4. UI Komponendid\n- ✅ &#96;Select&#96; komponent (Radix UI)\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; loading komponent\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent\n- ✅ &#96;Toast&#96; süsteem\n\n## 📋 Järgmised sammud (valikuline)\n\n### Prioriteet 1\n1. **Asendada kõik alert() kutsed toast'idega**\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n\n2. **Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine**\n   - Otsing välja\n   - Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n   - Sortimine\n\n3. **Parem error handling UI**\n   - Error boundaries\n   - Retry mechanisms\n\n### Prioriteet 2\n4. **Email notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n\n5. **Voucher mallid**\n   - Eeldefineeritud mallid\n   - Mallide salvestamine\n   - Kiire loomine\n\n6. **Export funktsioonid**\n   - CSV export redemptions\n   - Credits ledger export\n\n### Prioriteet 3\n7. **Graafikud ja visualisatsioonid**\n   - Chart.js või Recharts integratsioon\n   - Time-series graafikud\n   - Conversion funnels\n\n8. **Bulk operations**\n   - Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError(tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn'));\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('showQrToStaff'));\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('discountApplied', { amount: formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency) }));\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { Download } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { showSuccess, showError } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nexport default function ExportRedemptionsButton({ merchantSlug }: { merchantSlug: string }) {\n  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleExport = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsExporting(true);\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;/api/export/redemptions?merchantSlug=${merchantSlug}&#96;);\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('Export failed');\n      }\n\n      const blob = await response.blob();\n      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      const link = document.createElement('a');\n      link.href = url;\n      link.download = &#96;redemptions-${merchantSlug}-${Date.now()}.csv&#96;;\n      document.body.appendChild(link);\n      link.click();\n      document.body.removeChild(link);\n      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n\n      showSuccess('Redemptions exported successfully!');\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError('Failed to export redemptions');\n      console.error(error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsExporting(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button variant=\"outline\" onClick={handleExport} disabled={isExporting}&gt;\n      &lt;Download className=\"h-4 w-4 mr-2\" /&gt;\n      {isExporting ? 'Exporting...' : 'Export CSV'}\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function VoucherPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: { \n      merchant: true,\n      campaign: true,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!voucher || voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const voucherUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/v/${voucher.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(voucherUrl);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;VoucherClient\n      voucher={voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n}",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications System\n- ✅ Radix UI toast komponendid\n- ✅ Success, error, info variandid\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n- ✅ Helper funktsioonid (&#96;showSuccess&#96;, &#96;showError&#96;, &#96;showInfo&#96;)\n- ✅ Integreeritud root layout'is\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent spinner'iga\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; komponent loading state'ide jaoks\n- ✅ Näide kasutamisest &#96;publish-button.tsx&#96;'is\n\n### 3. Analytics Dashboard\n- ✅ Uus analytics leht (&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;)\n- ✅ Total redemptions, revenue, credits issued\n- ✅ Top vouchers statistika\n- ✅ Recent redemptions list\n- ✅ Link dashboard'ist\n\n### 4. UI Komponendid\n- ✅ &#96;Select&#96; komponent (Radix UI)\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; loading komponent\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent\n- ✅ &#96;Toast&#96; süsteem\n\n## 📋 Järgmised sammud (valikuline)\n\n### Prioriteet 1\n1. **Asendada kõik alert() kutsed toast'idega**\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n\n2. **Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine**\n   - Otsing välja\n   - Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n   - Sortimine\n\n3. **Parem error handling UI**\n   - Error boundaries\n   - Retry mechanisms\n\n### Prioriteet 2\n4. **Email notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n\n5. **Voucher mallid**\n   - Eeldefineeritud mallid\n   - Mallide salvestamine\n   - Kiire loomine\n\n6. **Export funktsioonid**\n   - CSV export redemptions\n   - Credits ledger export\n\n### Prioriteet 3\n7. **Graafikud ja visualisatsioonid**\n   - Chart.js või Recharts integratsioon\n   - Time-series graafikud\n   - Conversion funnels\n\n8. **Bulk operations**\n   - Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada",

        "contents": "function LoginForm() {\nconst handleEmailSignIn = async \n\n    await signIn('email', { email, callbackUrl });\n    setIsLoading(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4\"&gt;\n      &lt;Card className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n          &lt;CardTitle&gt;Sisselogimine&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n          &lt;CardDescription&gt;\n            Logi sisse e‑posti ja parooliga või sotsiaalvõrgustike kaudu\n          &lt;/CardDescription&gt;\n        &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n        &lt;CardContent className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n          &lt;form onSubmit={handleCredentialsSignIn} className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"space-y-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Label htmlFor=\"cred-email\"&gt;E‑post (kasutajanimi)&lt;/Label&gt;\n              &lt;Input\n                id=\"cred-email\"\n                name=\"email\"\n                type=\"email\"\n                placeholder=\"teie@näide.ee\"\n                value={email}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; setEmail(e.target.value)}\n                required\n              /&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"space-y-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Label htmlFor=\"cred-password\"&gt;Parool&lt;/Label&gt;\n              &lt;Input\n                id=\"cred-password\"\n                name=\"password\"\n                type=\"password\"\n                placeholder=\"••••••••\"\n                value={password}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; setPassword(e.target.value)}\n                required\n              /&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            {error &amp;&amp; &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-destructive\"&gt;{error}&lt;/p&gt;}\n            &lt;Button type=\"submit\" className=\"w-full\" disabled={isLoading}&gt;\n              {isLoading ? 'Palun oodake…' : 'Sisselogi'}\n            &lt;/Button&gt;\n          &lt;/form&gt;\n\n          {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' &amp;&amp; (\n            &lt;div className=\"rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:text-amber-100\"&gt;\n              &lt;span className=\"font-medium\"&gt;Testikasutaja:&lt;/span&gt; {TEST_EMAIL} / {TEST_PASSWORD}\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n          )}\n\n          &lt;div className=\"relative\"&gt;\n            &lt;div\n}",

        "contents": "interface VoucherClientProps {\n;\n  voucherCode: string;\n  qrCodeDataUrl: string;\n  isAuthenticated: boolean;\n  campaign?: any;\n}\n\nexport default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n  const [isPurchasing, setIsPurchasing] = useState(false);\n  const t = useTranslations('payment');\n  const tVoucher = useTranslations('voucher');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const tSuccess = useTranslations('success');\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n  \n  const hasPrice = campaign?.price !== null &amp;&amp; campaign?.price !== undefined;\n  const price = campaign?.price || 0;\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess(t('codeCopied'));\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handlePurchase = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!isAuthenticated) {\n      window.location.href = &#96;/login?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.href)}&#96;;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsPurchasing(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/vouchers/${voucher.id}/purchase&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({}),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const error = await res.json();\n        throw new Error(error.error || t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      if (data.url) {\n        window.location.href = data.url;\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t('purchaseFailed'));\n      setIsPurchasing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function NewVoucherPage() {\nconst handleSubmit = async \nconst designJson = {\n,\n        finePrint: formData.designFinePrint,\n        primaryColor: formData.designPrimaryColor,\n        secondaryColor: formData.designSecondaryColor,\n        backgroundColor: formData.designBackgroundColor,\n      };\n\n      const valueNum = parseInt(formData.value, 10);\n      if (Number.isNaN(valueNum)) throw new Error('Invalid value');\n\n      const body = {\n        type: formData.type,\n        value: formData.type === 'percentage' ? valueNum * 100 : valueNum * 100,\n        currency: formData.currency,\n        validFrom: new Date(formData.validFrom).toISOString(),\n        validTo: new Date(formData.validTo).toISOString(),\n        usageLimitTotal: formData.usageLimitTotal ? parseInt(formData.usageLimitTotal, 10) : undefined,\n        usageLimitPerUser: formData.usageLimitPerUser ? parseInt(formData.usageLimitPerUser, 10) : undefined,\n        weeklyDropEnabled: formData.weeklyDropEnabled,\n        weeklyDropJson,\n        designJson,\n        codePrefix: formData.codePrefix || undefined,\n      };\n\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/merchant/${merchantSlug}/vouchers&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify(body),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const d = await res.json().catch(() =&gt; ({}));\n        throw new Error(d.error || 'Failed to create voucher');\n      }\n      const voucher = await res.json();\n      router.push(&#96;/merchant/${merchantSlug}/vouchers/${voucher.id}&#96;);\n    }\n;\n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n      isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}\n    /&gt;\n  )\n}",

activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate\n\n;\n}",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp;         "contents": "export default async function MerchantDashboardPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\nconst [\n    activeVouchers,\n    activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await \n\n\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Revenue: sum of paid voucher purchases\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n      },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Outstanding liability: sum of voucher values for paid but unredeemed purchases\n    // We need to calculate this differently - sum of voucher.value where purchase is paid but not redeemed\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.findMany({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n        voucher: {\n          redemptions: {\n            none: {\n              confirmedAt: { not: null },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { value: true },\n        },\n      },\n    }),\n    // Ticket revenue: sum of paid ticket purchases\n    prisma.ticketPurchase.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n      },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Tickets sold count\n    prisma.ticket.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: { in: ['sold', 'used'] },\n      },\n    }),\n  ]);\n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n      isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}\n    /&gt;\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "export function generateStaticParams() {\n  return routing.locales.map((locale) =&gt; ({ locale }));\n}\n\nexport default async function LocaleLayout({\n  children,\n  params,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n  params: { locale: string } | Promise&lt;{ locale: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const p = await Promise.resolve(params);\n  const locale = p?.locale;\n  if (!locale || !routing.locales.includes(locale as (typeof routing.locales)[number])) {\n    redirect(&#96;/${routing.defaultLocale}&#96;);\n  }\n  setRequestLocale(locale);\n\n  let messages;\n  try {\n    messages = await getMessages();\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('[LocaleLayout] getMessages failed:', err);\n    }\n    throw err;\n  }\n\n  const t = await getTranslations('nav');\n}",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise staatus\n\n## ✅ Valmis\n\n1. **i18n konfiguratsioon**\n   - ✅ 5 keelt: en, et, es, fr, de\n   - ✅ Routing konfiguratsioon\n   - ✅ Middleware locale detection'iga\n\n2. **Tõlked**\n   - ✅ Inglise (en) - täielik\n   - ✅ Eesti (et) - täielik\n   - ✅ Hispaania (es) - täielik\n   - ✅ Prantsuse (fr) - täielik\n   - ✅ Saksa (de) - täielik\n\n3. **Komponendid**\n   - ✅ Language selector\n   - ✅ Locale-aware layout\n   - ✅ i18n utilities (valuuta, kuupäevad)\n\n4. **Dokumentatsioon**\n   - ✅ I18N_GUIDE.md - täielik juhend\n\n## ⚠️ Vajab täiendamist\n\n### 1. Olemasolevate lehtede migreerimine\n\nPraegu on palju lehti, mis ei kasuta tõlkeid. Need tuleb järk-järgult migreerida:\n\n**Prioriteet 1 (kõrge):**\n- &#96;app/login/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 2 (keskmine):**\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/dashboard/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet/page.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 3 (madal):**\n- Kõik ülejäänud lehed\n\n### 2. Kuidas migreerida lehte\n\n1. **Lisa &#96;useTranslations&#96; hook**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n   \n   const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Asenda hardcoded stringid**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // Enne:\n   &lt;h1&gt;Vouchers&lt;/h1&gt;\n   \n   // Pärast:\n   &lt;h1&gt;{t('vouchers')}&lt;/h1&gt;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Kasuta &#96;Link&#96; komponenti &#96;@/routing&#96;'ist**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { Link } from '@/routing';\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. URL struktuur\n\nPraegu:\n- &#96;/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (inglise keel)\n- &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (eesti keel)\n- &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (hispaania keel)\n\nKõik lehed peaksid toetama locale prefix'it.\n\n## 📝 Järgmised sammud\n\n1. **Migreeri kõige kasutatavamad lehed** (login, voucher, referral)\n2. **Testi kõik keeled**\n3. **Lisa puuduvad tõlked** (kui vaja)\n4. **Paranda URL struktuuri** (kui vaja)\n\n## 🎯 Eesmärk",

        "contents": "## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   ├── credits.ts        # Credit management\n│   └── merchant-status.ts # Launch mode (kill switch, feature flags)\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   ├── seed.ts           # Seed script\n│   └── migrations/       # Database migrations\n├── scripts/              # Utility scripts\n│   ├── verify-mvp-setup.ts    # Verify MVP setup\n│   ├── test-launch-mode.ts    # Test launch mode\n│   └── check-migrations.ts    # Check migration status\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { getCreditBalance } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\n\nexport async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { merchantSlug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(params.merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const balance = await getCreditBalance(session.user.id, merchant.id);\n\n    return NextResponse.json(balance);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching wallet:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",
