        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { Suspense } from 'react';\nimport { signIn } from 'next-auth/react';\nimport { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';\nimport { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\n\nconst TEST_EMAIL = 'test@example.com';\nconst TEST_PASSWORD = 'test123';\n\nfunction LoginForm() {\n  const searchParams = useSearchParams();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  const callbackUrl = searchParams.get('callbackUrl') ??         "contents": "export default async function AdminPage() {\nconst [merchantCount, userCount, voucherCount, redemptionCount, recentAuditLogs] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.merchant.count(),\n    prisma.user.count(),\n    prisma.voucher.count(),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n    }),\n    prisma.auditLog.findMany({\n      take: 10,\n      include: {\n        actor: {\n          select: {\n            email: true,\n            name: true,\n          },\n        },\n        merchant: {\n          select: {\n            name: true,\n            slug: true,\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: {\n        createdAt: 'desc',\n      },\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  // Serialize dates to strings and parse payloadJson for client component\n  const serializedAuditLogs = recentAuditLogs.map((log) =&gt; ({\n    ...log,\n    createdAt: log.createdAt.toISOString(),\n    payloadJson: safeParseJson&lt;AuditLogPayload&gt;(log.payloadJson),\n  }));\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen p-4\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"container mx-auto max-w-6xl\"&gt;\n        &lt;h1 className=\"text-3xl font-bold mb-6\"&gt;Platform Admin&lt;/h1&gt;\n\n        &lt;div className=\"grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 mb-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;Card&gt;\n            &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n              &lt;CardTitle className=\"text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground\"&gt;Merchants&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n            &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n            &lt;CardContent&gt;\n              &lt;p className=\"text-3xl font-bold\"&gt;{merchantCount}&lt;/p&gt;\n            &lt;/CardContent&gt;\n          &lt;/Card&gt;\n          &lt;Card&gt;\n            &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n              &lt;CardTitle className=\"text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground\"&gt;Users&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n            &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n            &lt;CardContent&gt;\n              &lt;p className=\"text-3xl font-bold\"&gt;{userCount}&lt;/p&gt;\n            &lt;/CardContent&gt;\n          &lt;/Card&gt;\n          &lt;Card&gt;\n            &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  let voucherId: string | undefined;\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const parsed = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n    voucherId = parsed.voucherId;\n    const { friendHint } = parsed;\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: parsed.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ?         "contents": "const createVoucherSchema = \n\n  designJson: z.any().optional(),\n  codePrefix: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_admin');\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createVoucherSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'draft',\n        ...data,\n        validFrom: new Date(data.validFrom),\n        validTo: new Date(data.validTo),\n        weeklyDropJson: data.weeklyDropJson ? JSON.stringify(data.weeklyDropJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n        conditionsJson: data.conditionsJson ? JSON.stringify(data.conditionsJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n        designJson: data.designJson ? JSON.stringify(data.designJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(voucher);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error) {\n      captureException(error, { \n        context: 'voucher_creation',\n        merchantSlug: params.slug\n\n}",

        "contents": "## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   ├── credits.ts        # Credit management\n│   └── merchant-status.ts # Launch mode (kill switch, feature flags)\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   ├── seed.ts           # Seed script\n│   └── migrations/       # Database migrations\n├── scripts/              # Utility scripts\n│   ├── verify-mvp-setup.ts    # Verify MVP setup\n│   ├── test-launch-mode.ts    # Test launch mode\n│   └── check-migrations.ts    # Check migration status\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "## Project Structure",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;text",
            "lineNumber": 127

            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "## Core Flows",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Configure weekly drop (optional)",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Publish voucher",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. User Shares Voucher",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "3. System creates referral and generates share URL",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Sees branded voucher with QR code",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Redeems online or in-store",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Locked credit created for referrer",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Confirms in-store redemption",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Credit unlocks for referrer",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5. Referrer Uses Credit",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Apply credit to order",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "## API Endpoints",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "See [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "### Merchant Vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher",
            "lineNumber": 201
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';\nimport { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createVoucherSchema = z.object({\n  type: z.enum(['percentage', 'fixed_amount', 'credit_amount']),\n  value: z.number().int().positive(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n  validFrom: z.string().datetime(),\n  validTo: z.string().datetime(),\n  usageLimitTotal: z.number().int().positive().optional(),\n  usageLimitPerUser: z.number().int().positive().optional(),\n  weeklyDropEnabled: z.boolean().default(false),\n  weeklyDropJson: z.any().optional(),\n  conditionsJson: z.any().optional(),\n  designJson: z.any().optional(),\n  codePrefix: z.string().optional(),\n});",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "contents": "import NextAuth from 'next-auth';\nimport { PrismaAdapter } from '@auth/prisma-adapter';\nimport EmailProvider from 'next-auth/providers/email';\nimport GoogleProvider from 'next-auth/providers/google';\nimport AppleProvider from 'next-auth/providers/apple';\nimport FacebookProvider from 'next-auth/providers/facebook';\nimport GitHubProvider from 'next-auth/providers/github';\nimport TwitterProvider from 'next-auth/providers/twitter';\nimport LinkedInProvider from 'next-auth/providers/linkedin';\nimport Credentials from 'next-auth/providers/credentials';\nimport { prisma } from './prisma';\n\nconst testEmail = process.env.TEST_USER_EMAIL ?? (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? 'test@example.com' : '');\nconst testPassword = process.env.TEST_USER_PASSWORD ?? (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? 'test123' : '');\n\nexport const { handlers, auth, signIn, signOut } = NextAuth({\n  adapter: PrismaAdapter(prisma),\n  providers: [\n    Credentials({\n      credentials: {\n        email: { label: 'Email', type: 'email' },\n        password: { label: 'Password', type: 'password' },\n      },\n      async authorize(credentials) {\n        if (!credentials?.email || typeof credentials.email !== 'string' || !credentials?.password || typeof credentials.password !== 'string') return null;\n        if (!testEmail || !testPassword) return null;\n        if (credentials.email !== testEmail || credentials.password !== testPassword) return null;\n        let user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: testEmail } });\n        if (!user) {\n          user = await prisma.user.create({ data: { email: testEmail, name: 'Test User' } });\n        }\n        return { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name ?? 'Test User' };\n      },\n    }),\n    EmailProvider({\n      server: {\n        host: process.env.SMTP_HOST,\n        port: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT) || 587,\n        auth: {\n          user: process.env.SMTP_USER,\n          pass: process.env.SMTP_PASSWORD,\n        },\n        from: process.env.SMTP_FROM || 'noreply@voucher-platform.com'\n\n;",

        "contents": "# API Documentation\n\n## Authentication\n\nMost endpoints require authentication via NextAuth session cookie. Merchant admin required\n\n**Body**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"type\": \"percentage\" | \"fixed_amount\" | \"credit_amount\",\n  \"value\": 1500,  // basis points for percentage, minor units for money\n  \"currency\": \"USD\",\n  \"validFrom\": \"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\n  \"validTo\": \"2024-01-31T23:59:59Z\",\n  \"usageLimitTotal\": 100,  // optional\n  \"usageLimitPerUser\": 1,  // optional\n  \"weeklyDropEnabled\": false,\n  \"weeklyDropJson\": {  // optional\n    \"dayOfWeek\": 1,\n    \"startTime\": \"10:00\",\n    \"stock\": 20,\n    \"durationMinutes\": 60\n  },\n  \"designJson\": {\n    \"headline\": \"15% Off\",\n    \"finePrint\": \"Valid for new customers\",\n    \"primaryColor\": \"#000000\",\n    \"secondaryColor\": \"#666666\",\n    \"backgroundColor\": \"#ffffff\"\n  },\n  \"codePrefix\": \"CH\"  // optional\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Response**: Voucher object\n\n#### List Vouchers\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nGET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Optional (public sees only published)\n\n**Response**: Array of voucher objects\n\n#### Get Voucher\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nGET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Required for non-published vouchers\n\n**Response**: Voucher object\n\n#### Update Voucher\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nPUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Merchant admin required\n\n**Body**: (all fields optional)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"status\": \"draft\" | \"published\" |         "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\redemptions\\route.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 18

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 179,

        },
        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst ;\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,\n        method: data.method,\n        orderReference: data.orderReference,\n        amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,\n        discountApplied: data.discountApplied,\n        currency: data.currency,\n        confirmedAt: null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n}",

        "contents": "// This is your Prisma schema file,\n// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema\n\ngenerator client {\n  provider = \"prisma-client-js\"\n}\n\ndatasource db {\n  provider = \"postgresql\"\n  url      = env(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n}\n\nmodel Account {\n  id                String  @id @default(cuid())\n  userId            String\n  type              String\n  provider          String\n  providerAccountId String\n  refresh_token     String? @db.Text\n  access_token      String? @db.Text\n  expires_at        Int?\n  token_type        String?\n  scope             String?\n  id_token          String? @db.Text\n  session_state     String?\n\n  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel Session {\n  id           String   @id @default(cuid())\n  sessionToken String   @unique\n  userId       String\n  expires      DateTime\n  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel VerificationToken {\n  identifier String\n  token      String   @unique\n  expires    DateTime\n\n  @@unique([identifier, token])\n}\n\nmodel User {\n  id            String    @id @default(cuid())\n  email         String    @unique\n  emailVerified DateTime?\n  name          String?\n  image         String?\n  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt\n\n  accounts         Account[]\n  sessions         Session[]\n  merchantMembers  MerchantMember[]\n  referrals        Referral[]         @relation(\"Referrer\")\n  redemptions      Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedBy\")\n  staffRedemptions Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedByStaff\")\n  creditLedgers    CreditLedger[]\n  creditUsages     CreditUsage[]\n  voucherPurchases VoucherPurchase[]\n  ticketPurchases  TicketPurchase[]\n  auditLogs        AuditLog[]\n}\n\nmodel Merchant {\n  ",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning\n\n### Where to Add Feature Flag Checks\n\nAdd feature flag checks to:\n\n1. **Weekly Drop Claim** (&#96;app/api/weekly-drop/claim/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; flag\n\n2. **Voucher Builder** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Show/hide weekly drop options based on flag\n\n3. **Analytics Dashboard** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/analytics/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; flag (V2)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n### Step 1: Create Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nINSERT INTO \"Merchant\" (id, name, slug, country, \"defaultCurrency\", \"isActive\", \"invitedAt\")\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  'New Merchant',\n  'new-merchant',\n  'US',\n  'USD',\n  true,\n  NOW()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Add Merchant Admin\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- First, create or find user\nINSERT INTO \"User\" (id, email, name, \"emailVerified\")\nVALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'admin@new-merchant.com', 'Admin', NOW())\nON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;\n\n-- Add as merchant admin\nINSERT INTO \"MerchantMember\" (id, \"merchantId\", \"userId\", role)\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  (SELECT id FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE slug = 'new-merchant'),\n  (SELECT id FROM \"User\" WHERE email = 'admin@new-merchant.com'),\n  'merchant_admin'\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Mark Onboarded\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"onboardedAt\" = NOW()\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'new-merchant';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Check Merchant Status\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  name,\n  slug,\n  \"isActive\",\n  \"invitedAt\",\n  \"onboardedAt\",\n  \"featureFlags\"\nFROM \"Merchant\"\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Audit Log\n\nAll kill switch actions are logged:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  \"createdAt\",\n  action,\n  \"payloadJson\"\nFROM \"AuditLog\"\nWHERE action IN ('merchant_activated', 'merchant_deactivated')\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Always check &#96;isActive&#96; before allowing writes** - Prevents creating vouchers for inactive merchants\n2. **Log all kill switch actions** - Use &#96;deactivateMerchant()&#96; and &#96;activateMerchant()&#96; functions",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

          },

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [Configuration Guide](docs/CONFIGURATION_GUIDE.md) - Complete configuration reference\n- [Setup Verification](docs/SETUP_VERIFICATION.md) - Verify MVP setup\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1.         "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96;         "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   ├── credits.ts        # Credit management\n│   └── merchant-status.ts # Launch mode (kill switch, feature flags)\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   ├── seed.ts           # Seed script\n│   └── migrations/       # Database migrations\n├── scripts/              # Utility scripts\n│   ├── verify-mvp-setup.ts    # Verify MVP setup\n│   ├── test-launch-mode.ts    # Test launch mode\n│   └── check-migrations.ts    # Check migration status\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher",

        "contents": "# V2 Backlog\n\n**DO NOT BUILD** - These features are explicitly forbidden in MVP and should only be documented for future consideration.\n\n## Forbidden Features (Per Specification)\n\n### Marketplace &amp; Discovery\n- ❌ Public marketplace/feed of vouchers\n- ❌ Deals feed\n- ❌ Ad network\n- ❌ Social platform features\n\n### Social Features\n- ❌ Comments on vouchers\n- ❌ Likes/reactions\n- ❌ Social sharing beyond native share sheet\n- ❌ User profiles/public pages\n\n### Loyalty &amp; Tiers\n- ❌ Loyalty tiers/levels\n- ❌ Points systems\n- ❌ Gamification\n\n### AI Features\n- ❌ AI-powered recommendations\n- ❌ AI-generated voucher designs\n- ❌ AI content generation\n\n### Advertising\n- ❌ Ad placements\n- ❌ Sponsored vouchers\n- ❌ Third-party advertising\n\n### Influencer Features\n- ❌ Influencer dashboards\n- ❌ Influencer-specific tools\n- ❌ Creator monetization\n\n## Potential V2 Features (Document Only)\n\nThese were mentioned in the specification as V2 backlog items:\n\n1. **Apple Wallet / Google Wallet**\n   - Add vouchers to native wallet apps\n   - QR codes in wallet format\n\n2. **Push Notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n   - Credit expiry warnings\n\n3. **Multi-language Selector**\n   - User-selectable language (beyond browser detection)\n   - Language preferences per user\n\n4. **Custom Domains**\n   - Merchant-branded domains\n   - White-label subdomains\n\n5. **POS Deep Integrations**\n   - Direct POS system integration\n   - Real-time inventory sync\n   - Automated redemption confirmation\n\n6. **Analytics Exports**\n   - PDF reports\n   - CSV exports (already have for redemptions)\n   - Scheduled reports\n\n7. **White-label Mode**\n   - Fully branded merchant experience\n   - Remove platform branding\n   - Custom email templates\n\n## Current Non-MVP Pages (For Reference)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in MVP scope:\n\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Platform admin (internal use for launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - Analytics dashboard (V2)",

        "contents": "# Pilot Program: First 10 Merchants\n\n**Referral Voucher + Merchant Credit** — proof, learning, testimonials.  \nNot scale.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Merchant Selection Checklist\n\nUse this **before** outreach. A prospect must satisfy ALL in Section A and at least one in Section B.  \nIf any Section A item is NO → skip.\n\n### Section A — Must have (all YES)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Local or regional business (not national/global) | | |\n| 2 | High trust, repeat customers (regulars) | | |\n| 3 | Easy-to-understand service or product | | |\n| 4 | Owner involved in daily operations | | |\n| 5 | Comfortable with WhatsApp, phone, or email | | |\n\n### Section B — Best fit (at least one)\n\n| # | Category | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Café or coffee shop | |\n| 2 | Salon or barbershop | |\n| 3 | Gym or studio | |\n| 4 | Tool rental or service business | |\n| 5 | Small retail with regulars | |\n\n### Section C — Exclude (any YES → skip)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Big chain or franchise | |\n| 2 | Pure e‑commerce (no in‑person/regulars) | |\n| 3 | Discount‑driven / race‑to‑bottom positioning | |\n\n**Verdict:** _________________________________ (IN / OUT)  \n**Reason if OUT:** _________________________________\n\n---\n\n## 2. Outreach Script\n\n### 2a. Opening (DM / WhatsApp / SMS)\n\n&gt; I’m testing a new way to turn your regular customers into your best salespeople, without ads.  \n&gt; Can I show you in 10 minutes?\n\n*If they say yes:*  \n&gt; When’s a good 10‑minute slot this week? I can call or stop by.\n\n*If they ask “what is it?”:*  \n&gt; Your customers get a simple voucher to share. When someone uses it, you give the sharer a bit of store credit. You control the offer and the credit. I’ll set it up with you.\n\n---\n\n### 2b. Phone / in‑person (10‑minute show)\n\n**Minute 0–1 — Hook**  \n&gt; You know your best new customers usually come from people who already like you. We’re testing a simple system: your regulars share a voucher, their friend uses it, you decide how much credit the sharer gets. No ads, you stay in control.\n\n**Minute 2–4 — What they get**  \n&gt; You get one main voucher — e.g. “15% off first visit” — and one weekly drop: a limited batch, e.g. 30 vouchers for 48 hours. When a friend redeems, your staff confirms in one tap. The referrer gets credit you set — e.g. €5 — to spend with you.",

          {
            "text": "## 2. Outreach Script",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2a. Opening (DM / WhatsApp / SMS)",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; I’m testing a new way to turn your regular customers into your best salespeople, without ads.  ",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; Can I show you in 10 minutes?",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "*If they say yes:*  ",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; When’s a good 10‑minute slot this week? I can call or stop by.",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "*If they ask “what is it?”:*  ",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; Your customers get a simple voucher to share. When someone uses it, you give the sharer a bit of store credit. You control the offer and the credit. I’ll set it up with you.",

            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2b. Phone / in‑person (10‑minute show)",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "**Minute 0–1 — Hook**  ",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; You know your best new customers usually come from people who already like you. We’re testing a simple system: your regulars share a voucher, their friend uses it, you decide how much credit the sharer gets. No ads, you stay in control.",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "**Minute 2–4 — What they get**  ",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; You get one main voucher — e.g. “15% off first visit” — and one weekly drop: a limited batch, e.g. 30 vouchers for 48 hours. When a friend redeems, your staff confirms in one tap. The referrer gets credit you set — e.g. €5 — to spend with you.",
            "lineNumber": 67
          }
        ]

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [Configuration Guide](docs/CONFIGURATION_GUIDE.md) - Complete configuration reference\n- [Setup Verification](docs/SETUP_VERIFICATION.md) - Verify MVP setup\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "Use only after a **GO** and when the merchant has seen some results.\n\n&gt; This has been free while we tested.  \n&gt; If we keep this running, it will be a small monthly fee plus a small cost per successful referral.  \n&gt; We can talk numbers when you’re ready — no pressure.\n\n**Do NOT push pricing. Gauge reaction.**\n\n- If positive: *“I’ll send you the options in a couple of days.”*\n- If hesitant: *“No rush. We can run another week or two as is and then decide.”*\n- If no: *“Understood. We’ll turn it off when you prefer. Thanks for trying it.”*\n\n---\n\n## 7. Action Plan — Week by Week\n\nDo in order. Adjust dates to your start.\n\n### Before you start\n\n| # | Task | ✓ |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | List 15–20 candidate businesses (use Section 1 checklist; aim to get 10 IN) | |\n| 2 | Get contact: WhatsApp, phone, or email for owner / decision‑maker | |\n| 3 | Prepare: demo &#96;/v/[id]&#96; and &#96;/r/[id]&#96; live or screens; 10‑min script (Section 2b) | |\n| 4 | Tracker: spreadsheet/notion with columns — Merchant, Category, Go‑live, Vouchers shared, Referrals, Redemptions, Credits earned, Credits used | |\n\n---\n\n### Week 1 — List + outreach\n\n| Day | Task |\n| --- | --- |\n| 1–2 | Run checklist on 15–20; mark IN/OUT. Pick first 5–7 to contact. |\n| 3–5 | DM/call using Section 2. Book 10‑min shows. In‑person best where possible. |\n| 6–7 | Do 10‑min shows. Close: “Want to try for a few weeks?” Aim: 3–5 said yes. |\n\n*If too few yes: add 5 more from list, repeat. Don’t change script yet.*\n\n---\n\n### Week 2 — Setup + go‑live\n\n| Day | Task |\n| --- | --- |\n| 1–3 | Setup sessions (Section 3) with each yes. One session per merchant. |\n| 4–5 | All 10 not reached? — outreach to more from list until you have 10. |\n| 6–7 | Every merchant: 1 voucher live, 1 weekly drop on, staff shown redeem. Log go‑live dates. |\n\n**Rule:** 7 days with zero referrals → tweak offer/credit/drop for that merchant first; don’t change product.\n\n---\n\n### Week 3–4 — Run + 7–10 day feedback\n\n| When | Task |",

        "contents": "| Objection | Response |\n| --- | --- |\n| \"Isn't this just coupons?\" | No. Coupons discount. This rewards referrals. |\n| \"Will people abuse it?\" | Credits are locked, controlled, and merchant-specific. |\n| \"Do I need an app?\" | No. It works instantly on any phone. |\n\n---\n\n## Demo pitch (under 3 minutes)\n\n**Order:** 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6.\n\n1. **Open voucher landing** — Show &#96;/v/[id]&#96;, merchant brand, value, one clear CTA.\n2. **Share** — Tap \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\", get &#96;/r/[id]&#96;, show native share or copy.\n3. **Redeem as friend** — Open link in new session, redeem online or in-store (QR).\n4. **Confirm** — Staff confirms in dashboard; show redemption moving to \"Confirmed\".\n5. **Credit unlock** — Show referrer's wallet: locked → available after confirm.\n6. **Apply credit** — Checkout demo: apply credit, new total. Done.\n\n**Talking point:** \"Branded, tracked, controlled by you. You only pay when it works.\"",

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Brand Positioning\n\n**Product name:** Vouchr  \n**Tagline:** Pay for results, not reach.\n\n---\n\n## One-paragraph positioning\n\nVouchr is merchant-owned referral infrastructure for local and regional businesses that rely on word-of-mouth. Instead of coupons, ads, or a marketplace, it lets you issue branded vouchers, turn loyal customers into a measurable, reward-based distribution channel, and pay them in your own store credit when their friends buy. You keep control of the brand and the relationship, and you only pay when a referred customer converts—not for clicks or impressions. Referral, measured and rewarded, for SMBs who want new customers and trust without losing control or budget to low-ROI ads.\n\n---\n\n## 10-second spoken pitch\n\n&gt; When a customer shares your voucher with a friend and that friend buys, the customer earns your store credit. It’s all branded, tracked, and controlled by you—and you only pay when it works.\n\n---\n\n## Homepage hero (1 sentence)\n\n&gt; Turn your best customers into your best salespeople—and only pay when it actually works.\n\n---\n\n## Core promise\n\n&gt; Turn your best customers into your best salespeople—and only pay when it actually works.\n\n---\n\n## What to say / not say\n\n**Never say:** discount platform, deal site, promo tool.  \n**Always say:** referral, credit, merchant-owned, pay-for-results.\n\n---\n\n## ICP\n\n- **Primary:** Local &amp; regional merchants (cafes, salons, gyms, rentals, services, retail); SMBs who rely on word-of-mouth; businesses tired of ads with unclear ROI.\n- **Secondary:** Franchise-style and multi-location SMBs.\n- **Not for:** Influencer marketers, big-brand ad buyers, discount hunters.\n\n---\n\n## Pricing positioning (no numbers)\n\n- Infrastructure, not marketing.\n- Cheaper than ads.\n- Pay only when value is created.  \n**Phrase:** \"You pay for customers, not clicks.\"\n\n---\n\n## Objection handling\n\n| Objection | Response |\n| --- | --- |\n| \"Isn't this just coupons?\" | No. Coupons discount. This rewards referrals. |\n| \"Will people abuse it?\" | Credits are locked, controlled, and merchant-specific. |",

await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}&#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "interface VoucherClientProps {\n;\n  voucherCode: string;\n  qrCodeDataUrl: string;\n  isAuthenticated: boolean;\n  campaign?: any;\n}\n\nexport default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n  const [isPurchasing, setIsPurchasing] = useState(false);\n  const t = useTranslations('payment');\n  const tVoucher = useTranslations('voucher');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const tSuccess = useTranslations('success');\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n  \n  const hasPrice = campaign?.price !== null &amp;&amp; campaign?.price !== undefined;\n  const price = campaign?.price || 0;\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess(t('codeCopied'));\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handlePurchase = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!isAuthenticated) {\n      window.location.href = &#96;/login?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.href)}&#96;;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsPurchasing(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/vouchers/${voucher.id}/purchase&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({}),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const error = await res.json();\n        throw new Error(error.error || t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      if (data.url) {\n        window.location.href = data.url;\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t('purchaseFailed'));\n      setIsPurchasing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  merchant Merchant @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  user     User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([merchantId, userId])\n  @@index([merchantId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel Campaign {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())\n  merchantId      String\n  name            String\n  description     String?\n  type            String   // weekly | limited\n  startDate       DateTime\n  endDate         DateTime\n  price           Int?     // minor units, null = free\n  discountRules   Json?    // { type, value, currency }\n  maxRedemptions  Int?\n  maxPurchases    Int?\n  terms           String?\n  creditPercentage Int?    // % of purchase price as credit (basis points, e.g. 500 = 5%)\n  status          String   @default(\"draft\") // draft | active | ended\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  merchant Merchant @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  vouchers Voucher[]\n  purchases VoucherPurchase[]\n\n  @@index([merchantId])\n  @@index([status])\n  @@index([startDate, endDate])\n}\n\nmodel Voucher {\n  id                String   @id @default(cuid())\n  merchantId        String\n  campaignId        String?\n  status            String   @default(\"draft\") // draft | published | paused | ended\n  type              String   // percentage | fixed_amount | credit_amount\n  value             Int      // minor units for money, basis points for percentage\n  currency          String\n  validFrom         DateTime\n  validTo           DateTime\n  usageLimitTotal   Int?\n  usageLimitPerUser Int?\n  weeklyDropEnabled Boolean  @default(false)\n  weeklyDropJson    Json?\n  conditionsJson    Json?\n  designJson        Json?",

        "contents": "## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   ├── credits.ts        # Credit management\n│   └── merchant-status.ts # Launch mode (kill switch, feature flags)\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   ├── seed.ts           # Seed script\n│   └── migrations/       # Database migrations\n├── scripts/              # Utility scripts\n│   ├── verify-mvp-setup.ts    # Verify MVP setup\n│   ├── test-launch-mode.ts    # Test launch mode\n│   └── check-migrations.ts    # Check migration status\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",
