        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n      isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}\n    /&gt;\n  )\n}",

          },

          },

          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "    notFound();",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  const session = await auth();",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Generate voucher code",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "  if (referral.status === 'created') {",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "    await prisma.referral.update({",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "      where: { id: referral.id },",

          },
          {
            "text": "      data: { status: 'opened' },",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    });",

          },
          {
            "text": "  }",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },

          },

          },

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError(tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn'));\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('showQrToStaff'));\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('discountApplied', { amount: formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency) }));\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst ;\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,\n        method: data.method,\n        orderReference: data.orderReference,\n        amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,\n        discountApplied: data.discountApplied,\n        currency: data.currency,\n        confirmedAt: null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n}",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check validity dates\n    const now = new Date();\n    if (now &lt; voucher.validFrom || now &gt; voucher.validTo) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher expired or not yet valid' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check usage limits\n    if (voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n      const totalRedemptions = await prisma.redemption.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          confirmedAt: { not: null },\n        },\n      });\n      if (totalRedemptions &gt;= voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher usage limit reached' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits\n    if (data.referralId &amp;&amp; session?.user?.id) {\n      const isSelf = await isSelfReferral(data.referralId, session.user.id);\n      if (isSelf) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cannot redeem your own referral' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        const rateLimit = await checkRedemptionRateLimit(referral.friendHash);\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return\n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function VoucherPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: { \n      merchant: true,\n      campaign: true,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!voucher || voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const voucherUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/v/${voucher.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(voucherUrl);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;VoucherClient\n      voucher={voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n}",

          "endPosition": {

            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "| Objection | Response |\n| --- | --- |\n| \"Isn't this just coupons?\" | No. Coupons discount. Done.\n\n**Talking point:** \"Branded, tracked, controlled by you. You only pay when it works.\"",

Earn Credit\" (requires login)\n   - Copy the referral link\n\n5. **Redeem voucher**:\n   - Open referral link in incognito/private window\n   - Enter order amount and click \"Redeem Online\"\n\n6. **Confirm redemption** (as staff):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/redemptions&gt;\n   - Click \"Confirm Redemption\" on pending redemptions\n\n7. **View credit wallet**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/wallet&gt;\n   - See unlocked credit\n\n8. **Apply credit**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/checkout-demo&gt;\n   - Enter order amount and apply credit\n\n## Seed Data\n\nThe seed script creates:\n\n- 2 merchants (Coffee House, Tech Store)\n- 3 users: [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (parool: test123), [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com)\n- Sample vouchers, referrals, and credits\n\n&#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96; tagab [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) ja Coffee House liikmelisuse ka siis, kui seed on juba käivitatud.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n**Docker Desktop not starting**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:check&#96;         "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [Configuration Guide](docs/CONFIGURATION_GUIDE.md) - Complete configuration reference\n- [Setup Verification](docs/SETUP_VERIFICATION.md) - Verify MVP setup\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

          }

        "contents": "**Minute 0–1 — Hook**  \n&gt; You know your best new customers usually come from people who already like you. We’re testing a simple system: your regulars share a voucher, their friend uses it, you decide how much credit the sharer gets. No ads, you stay in control.\n\n**Minute 2–4 — What they get**  \n&gt; You get one main voucher — e.g. “15% off first visit” — and one weekly drop: a limited batch, e.g. 30 vouchers for 48 hours. When a friend redeems, your staff confirms in one tap. The referrer gets credit you set — e.g. €5 — to spend with you.\n\n**Minute 5–7 — Why pilot**  \n&gt; I’m running this with 10 local businesses to see what works. For the pilot it’s free, I do the setup with you, and you get your own branded voucher. In return I’d want a short feedback call and, if it works, your okay to use the results.\n\n**Minute 8–10 — Close**  \n&gt; No contract. If it doesn’t fit, we stop. Want to try it for a few weeks?\n\n---\n\n### 2c. Do NOT say\n\n- “startup”\n- “beta”\n- “platform”\n- “app”\n\nUse: “we’re testing,” “system,” “voucher,” “credit,” “weekly drop.”\n\n---\n\n### 2d. Objection short replies\n\n| Objection | Reply |\n| --- | --- |\n| “I don’t have time.” | “Setup is one short session. After that it runs itself. 10 minutes to see it?” |\n| “Will it cost me?” | “Pilot is free. If we continue after, it would be a small monthly fee and a small amount per referral. We can talk then.” |\n| “My customers won’t share.” | “That’s what we’re testing. If almost no one shares, we’ll change the offer or drop it. No risk for you.” |\n| “I already have loyalty / discounts.” | “This is different: they only get credit when they bring a new person who actually shows up. It rewards bringing new customers.” |\n\n---\n\n## 3. Pilot Setup Checklist (per merchant)\n\nDo this in one session. Check each when done.\n\n### Before the session\n\n| # | Task | ✓ |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Merchant has accepted pilot (verbal or short written ok) | |\n| 2 | You have: business name, main offer in one sentence, contact for staff | |",

await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}&#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Check rate limits for referral creation\n */\nexport async function checkReferralRateLimit(\n  userId: string,\n  windowMinutes: number = 60,\n  maxAttempts: number = 10\n): Promise&lt;{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number }&gt; {\n  const windowStart = new Date(Date.now() - windowMinutes * 60 * 1000);\n\n  const recentCount = await prisma.referral.count({\n    where: {\n      referrerUserId: userId,\n      createdAt: {\n        gte: windowStart,\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  return {\n    allowed: recentCount &lt; maxAttempts,\n    remaining: Math.max(0, maxAttempts - recentCount),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Check rate limits for redemption attempts\n */\nexport async function checkRedemptionRateLimit(\n  friendHash: string,\n  windowMinutes: number = 60,\n  maxAttempts: number = 5\n): Promise&lt;{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number }&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n      isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}\n    /&gt;\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchantSlug = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('merchantSlug');\n    if (!merchantSlug) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant slug required' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: merchantSlug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n    const redemptions = await prisma.redemption.findMany({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { id: true, type: true },\n        },\n        referral: {\n          include: {\n            referrer: {\n              select: { name: true, email: true },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    // Generate CSV\n    const headers = [\n      'ID',\n      'Voucher ID',\n      'Voucher Type',\n      'Method',\n      'Order Reference',\n      'Amount Before Discount',\n      'Discount Applied',\n      'Currency',\n      'Referrer',\n      'Confirmed At',\n      'Created At',\n    ];\n\n    const rows = redemptions.map((r) =&gt; [\n      r.id,\n      r.voucher.id,\n      r.voucher.type,\n      r.method,\n      r.orderReference || '',\n      String(r.amountBeforeDiscount / 100),\n      String(r.discountApplied / 100),\n      r.currency,\n      r.referral?.referrer?.email || '',\n      r.confirmedAt ? new Date(r.confirmedAt).toISOString() : '',\n      new Date(r.createdAt).toISOString(),\n    ]);\n\n    const csv = [\n      headers.join(','),\n      ...rows.map((row) =&gt; row.map((cell) =&gt; &#96;\"${cell}\"&#96;).join(',')),\n    ].join('\\n');\n\n    return new NextResponse(csv,\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst ;\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,\n        method: data.method,\n        orderReference: data.orderReference,\n        amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,\n        discountApplied: data.discountApplied,\n        currency: data.currency,\n        confirmedAt: null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\n\nexport default async function AnalyticsPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const         "contents": "## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   ├── credits.ts        # Credit management\n│   └── merchant-status.ts # Launch mode (kill switch, feature flags)\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   ├── seed.ts           # Seed script\n│   └── migrations/       # Database migrations\n├── scripts/              # Utility scripts\n│   ├── verify-mvp-setup.ts    # Verify MVP setup\n│   ├── test-launch-mode.ts    # Test launch mode\n│   └── check-migrations.ts    # Check migration status\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError(tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn'));\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('showQrToStaff'));\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('discountApplied', { amount: formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency) }));\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

   - Quick Actions (piletid, maksed, profiil)
   - Merchant Memberships

2. Generaatorite funktsioonid nähtavad:
   - "Share Vouchers" kaart — viitab voucherite lehele, kus saab jagada ja luua referral linke
   - "My Referrals" kaart — näitab statistikat (mitu jagatud, mitu redeemed) ja viitab `/app/share` lehele
   - "How It Works" kaart — selgitab protsessi

3. Lisatud referral statistika:
   - Kogus jagatud vouchereid
   - Kogus redeemed vouchereid
   - Viide täpsemale statistikale

Nüüd on näha, kuidas:
- Jagada vouchereid (Browse Vouchers → Share & Earn Credit nupp)
- Luua referral linke (automaatselt, kui jagad voucherit)
- Vaadata oma referral statistikat

Leht on loogilisemalt korrastatud ja generaatorite funktsioonid on selgelt nähtavad.

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96;         "contents": "import Link from 'next/link';\nimport { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { getCreditBalance } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\n\nexport default async function WalletPage({ params }: { params: { merchantSlug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) redirect('/login');\n\n  const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(params.merchantSlug);\n  if (!merchant) notFound();\n\n  const balance = await getCreditBalance(session.user.id, merchant.id);\n  const available = balance.available;\n  const locked = balance.locked;\n  const hasAvailable = available &gt; 0;\n\n  return\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\n\nexport default async function ReferralsPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  // Get referral analytics\n  const [\n    totalReferrals,\n    openedReferrals,\n    redeemedReferrals,\n    topReferrers,\n    referralStats,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.referral.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: { in: ['opened', 'redeemed'] },\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'redeemed',\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.groupBy({\n      by: ['referrerUserId'],\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _count: { id: true },\n      orderBy: { _count: { id: 'desc' } },\n      take: 10,\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.groupBy({\n      by: ['status'],\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _count: { id: true },\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  // Get user details for top referrers\n  const topReferrerIds = topReferrers.map((r) =&gt; r.referrerUserId);\n  const topReferrerUsers = await prisma.user.findMany({\n    where: { id: { in: topReferrerIds } },\n    select: { id: true, name: true, email: true },\n  });\n\n  const conversionRate = totalReferrals &gt; 0\n    ? ((redeemedReferrals / totalReferrals) * 100).toFixed(1)\n    : '0.0';\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error) {\n      captureException(error, { \n        context: 'voucher_creation',\n        merchantSlug: params.slug \n      });\n    }\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // If authenticated and has merchant role, show all vouchers\n    // Otherwise, show only published vouchers\n    const where: {\n      merchantId: string;\n      status?: string;\n    } = { merchantId: merchant.id };\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      where.status = 'published';\n    } else {\n      try {\n        await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n      } catch {\n        where.status = 'published';\n      }\n    }\n\n    const vouchers = await prisma.voucher.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(vouchers);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { startOfDay, startOfWeek } from 'date-fns';\nimport { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from redirect('/login');\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({ where: { slug: params.slug } });\n  if (!merchant) notFound();\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const dayStart = startOfDay(now);\n  const weekStart = startOfWeek(now, { weekStartsOn: 1 });\n\n  const [\n    activeVouchers,\n    activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.voucher.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'published' } }),\n prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate\n\n;\n}",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;         "contents": "The &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { isFeatureEnabled } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Check if weekly drops are enabled for merchant\nconst weeklyDropsEnabled = await isFeatureEnabled(merchantId, 'weeklyDropsEnabled');\n\nif (weeklyDropsEnabled) {\n  // Show weekly drop options\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Set Feature Flags\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Enable weekly drops for a merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = jsonb_set(\n  COALESCE(\"featureFlags\", '{}'::jsonb),\n  '{weeklyDropsEnabled}',\n  'true'::jsonb\n)\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Disable a feature\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = jsonb_set(\n  COALESCE(\"featureFlags\", '{}'::jsonb),\n  '{weeklyDropsEnabled}',\n  'false'::jsonb\n)\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Set multiple flags\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = '{\"weeklyDropsEnabled\": true, \"analyticsEnabled\": false}'::jsonb\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Available Feature Flags\n\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; - Enable weekly drop functionality\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; - Enable analytics dashboard (V2)\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled&#96; - Enable custom domains (V2)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled&#96; - Enable white-label mode (V2)\n\n## Integration Points\n\n### Where to Add Kill Switch Checks\n\nAdd &#96;requireActiveMerchant()&#96; checks to:\n\n1. **Voucher Creation** (&#96;app/api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Block new vouchers for inactive merchants\n\n2. **Voucher Publishing** (&#96;app/api/vouchers/[id]/publish/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Block publishing for inactive merchants\n\n3. **Public Voucher Pages** (&#96;app/v/[id]/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Hide vouchers from inactive merchants\n\n4. **Public Referral Pages** (&#96;app/r/[id]/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Hide referrals from inactive merchants\n\n5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning",

        "contents": "export default async function MerchantDashboardPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\nconst [\n    activeVouchers,\n    activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await \n\n\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Revenue: sum of paid voucher purchases\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n      },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Outstanding liability: sum of voucher values for paid but unredeemed purchases\n    // We need to calculate this differently - sum of voucher.value where purchase is paid but not redeemed\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.findMany({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n        voucher: {\n          redemptions: {\n            none: {\n              confirmedAt: { not: null },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { value: true },\n        },\n      },\n    }),\n    // Ticket revenue: sum of paid ticket purchases\n    prisma.ticketPurchase.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n      },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Tickets sold count\n    prisma.ticket.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: { in: ['sold', 'used'] },\n      },\n    }),\n  ]);\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { safeParseJson } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { AuditLogPayload } from '@/types';\nimport MerchantsTable from './merchants-table';\nimport AuditLogView from './audit-log-view';\n\nfunction isPlatformAdmin(email: string | null | undefined): boolean {\n  if (!email) return false;\n  const adminEmails = process.env.PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS?.split(',').map(e =&gt; e.trim()) || [];\n  return adminEmails.includes(email);\n}\n\nexport default async function AdminPage() {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  if (!isPlatformAdmin(session.user.email)) {\n    redirect('/app');\n  }\n\n  const [merchantCount, userCount, voucherCount, redemptionCount, recentAuditLogs] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.merchant.count(),\n    prisma.user.count(),\n;\n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function VoucherPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: { \n      merchant: true,\n      campaign: true,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!voucher || voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const voucherUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/v/${voucher.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(voucherUrl);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;VoucherClient\n      voucher={voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n}",

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

            "line": 148

        },
        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "name: voucher",

          },

            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "# Voucher Rules",
            "lineNumber": 6

          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "Ainus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "Kui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.",
            "lineNumber": 12

        "contents": "## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   ├── credits.ts        # Credit management\n│   └── merchant-status.ts # Launch mode (kill switch, feature flags)\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   ├── seed.ts           # Seed script\n│   └── migrations/       # Database migrations\n├── scripts/              # Utility scripts\n│   ├── verify-mvp-setup.ts    # Verify MVP setup\n│   ├── test-launch-mode.ts    # Test launch mode\n│   └── check-migrations.ts    # Check migration status\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide\n\nThis guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;\n\n2. Regenerate Prisma client:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma generate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kill Switch\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:\n- Merchant is hidden from public routes\n- New voucher creation is blocked\n- Existing redemptions can complete\n- All actions are logged to AuditLog\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Deactivate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)\nawait deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Activate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Activate merchant\nawait activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // ... auth checks ...\n  \n  // Check merchant is active\n  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n  \n  // Continue with voucher creation...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SQL Direct Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Activate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Check status\nSELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Feature Flags\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "This guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Prerequisites",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "npx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "Or manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Regenerate Prisma client:",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "npx prisma generate",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### How It Works",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "The &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Merchant is hidden from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- New voucher creation is blocked",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- Existing redemptions can complete",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- All actions are logged to AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "### Usage",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "await deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Activate a Merchant",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "import { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "// Activate merchant",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "await activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },

            "lineNumber": 51

        "contents": "export async function unlockCreditForRedemption(\n  redemptionId: string,\n  merchantId: string\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n,\n  });\n\n  // Send email notification\n  if (redemption.referral.referrer.email) {\n    try {\n      const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n        where: { id: merchantId },\n        select: { name: true, slug: true },\n      });\n\n      if (merchant) {\n        // Get updated balance\n        const balance = await getCreditBalance(redemption.referral.referrerUserId, merchantId);\n        const walletUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'}/app/${merchant.slug}/wallet&#96;;\n\n        await sendCreditUnlocked({\n          to: redemption.referral.referrer.email,\n          merchantName: merchant.name,\n          creditAmount: (lockedCredit.amount / 100).toFixed(2),\n          currency: lockedCredit.currency.toUpperCase(),\n          totalBalance: (balance.total / 100).toFixed(2),\n          walletUrl,\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Don't fail unlock if email fails\n      console.error('Error sending credit unlocked email:', error);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Get user's credit balance for a merchant\n */\nexport async function getCreditBalance(\n  userId: string,\n  merchantId: string\n): Promise&lt;{\n  available: number;\n  locked: number;\n  total: number;\n  currency: string;\n  credits: Array&lt;{\n    id: string;\n    amount: number;\n    status: string;\n    expiresAt: Date | null;\n    createdAt: Date;\n  }&gt;;\n}&gt; {\n  const credits = await prisma.creditLedger.findMany({\n    where: {\n      userId,\n      merchantId,\n      status: {\n        in: ['available', 'locked'],\n      },\n    },\n    orderBy: {\n      createdAt: 'desc',\n    },\n  });\n}",

        "contents": "export async function applyCredit(\n  userId: string,\n  merchantId: string,\n  amount: number,\n  orderReference: string\n): Promise&lt;{ success: boolean; creditIds: string[] }&gt; {\nconst availableCredits = await ({\n    where: {\n      userId,\n      merchantId,\n      status: 'available',\n      OR: [\n        { expiresAt: null },\n        { expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },\n      ],\n    },\n    orderBy: [\n      { expiresAt: 'asc' }, // Use expiring credits first\n      { createdAt: 'asc' },\n    ],\n  });\n\n  let remaining = amount;\n  const creditIds: string[] = [];\n  const creditsToUse: Array&lt;{ id: string; amount: number }&gt; = [];\n\n  for (const credit of availableCredits) {\n    if (remaining &lt;= 0) break;\n\n    const useAmount = Math.min(remaining, credit.amount);\n    creditsToUse.push({ id: credit.id, amount: useAmount });\n    creditIds.push(credit.id);\n    remaining -= useAmount;\n  }\n\n  if (remaining &gt; 0) {\n    throw new Error('Insufficient credit balance');\n  }\n\n  // Use transaction to atomically update credits and create usage record\n  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n    // Mark credits as used (or partially used)\n    for (const { id, amount: useAmount } of creditsToUse) {\n      const credit = await tx.creditLedger.findUnique({\n        where: { id },\n      });\n\n      if (!credit) continue;\n\n      if (useAmount === credit.amount) {\n        // Fully used\n        await tx.creditLedger.update({\n          where: { id },\n          data: { status: 'used' },\n        });\n      } else {\n        // Partially used - create new ledger entry for remaining\n        await tx.creditLedger.update({\n          where: { id },\n          data: { status: 'used' },\n        });\n        await tx.creditLedger.create({\n          data: {\n            merchantId,\n            userId,\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { prisma } from './prisma';\n\n/**\n * Ensure a resource belongs to the specified merchant (tenant isolation)\n */\nexport async function ensureMerchantOwnership(\n  resourceType: 'voucher' | 'referral' | 'redemption' | 'creditLedger',\n  resourceId: string,\n  merchantId: string\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  switch (resourceType) {\n    case 'voucher': {\n      const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          id: resourceId,\n          merchantId,\n        },\n      });\n      return !!voucher;\n    }\n    case 'referral': {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          id: resourceId,\n          merchantId,\n        },\n      });\n      return !!referral;\n    }\n    case 'redemption': {\n      const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          id: resourceId,\n          merchantId,\n        },\n      });\n      return !!redemption;\n    }\n    case 'creditLedger': {\n      const credit = await prisma.creditLedger.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          id: resourceId,\n          merchantId,\n        },\n      });\n      return !!credit;\n    }\n    default:\n      return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Get merchant by slug\n */\nexport async function getMerchantBySlug(slug: string) {\n  return prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug },\n  });\n}",

## Loodud

**Uus fail:**
- `app/campaigns/page.tsx` — avalik kampaania leht

**Muudetud fail:**
- `app/(user)/app/page.tsx` — lisatud link kampaania lehele

### Funktsioonid:

1. Kampaania kaardid:
   - Kampaania nimi ja kirjeldus
   - Tüüp (nädalane/piiratud)
   - Alla hindluse info (protsent või summa)
   - Hind (või "TASUTA" märge)
   - Statistika (voucherite arv, ostude arv)
   - Kehtivuse kuupäevad

2. Voucherite eelvaade:
   - Kuni 5 voucherit kampaania kohta
   - Voucherite pealkirjad ja väärtused
   - Linkid otse voucheritele
   - "Vaata veel" indikaator, kui on rohkem vouchereid

3. Filtreerimine:
   - Näitab ainult aktiivseid kampaaniaid
   - Peidab inaktiivsete merchant'ide kampaaniaid
   - Näitab ainult kehtivaid vouchereid

4. Disain:
   - Responsive grid layout
   - Merchant'i brändivärvid
   - Hover efektid
   - Selge info hierarhia

5. Navigeerimine:
   - Link kampaania detailile
   - Linkid voucheritele
   - Link tagasi avalehele (kui kampaaniaid pole)

Leht on saadaval `/campaigns` aadressil ja on linkitud `/app` lehelt.

        "contents": "/**\n * Check if user has a specific role for a merchant\n */\nexport async function hasMerchantRole(\n  userId: string,\n  merchantId: string,\n  requiredRole: 'merchant_admin' | 'merchant_staff'\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const member = await prisma.merchantMember.findUnique({\n    where: {\n      merchantId_userId: {\n        merchantId,\n        userId,\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!member) return false;\n\n  if (requiredRole === 'merchant_admin') {\n    return member.role === 'merchant_admin';\n  }\n\n  // merchant_staff can access merchant_staff routes, merchant_admin can access both\n  return member.role === 'merchant_admin' || member.role === 'merchant_staff';\n}\n\n/**\n * Check if user is platform admin\n * For now, we'll use a simple env-based check.         "contents": "import { prisma } from './prisma';\n\n/**\n * Ensure a resource belongs to the specified merchant (tenant isolation)\n */\nexport async function ensureMerchantOwnership(\n  resourceType: 'voucher' | 'referral' | 'redemption' | 'creditLedger',\n  resourceId: string,\n  merchantId: string\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  switch (resourceType) {\n    case 'voucher': {\n      const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          id: resourceId,\n          merchantId,\n        },\n      });\n      return !!voucher;\n    }\n    case 'referral': {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          id: resourceId,\n          merchantId,\n        },\n      });\n      return !!referral;\n    }\n    case 'redemption': {\n      const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          id: resourceId,\n          merchantId,\n        },\n      });\n      return !!redemption;\n    }\n    case 'creditLedger': {\n      const credit = await prisma.creditLedger.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          id: resourceId,\n          merchantId,\n        },\n      });\n      return !!credit;\n    }\n    default:\n      return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Get merchant by slug\n */\nexport async function getMerchantBySlug(slug: string) {\n  return prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug },\n  });\n}",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "import { prisma } from './prisma';\nimport { sendCreditUnlocked } from './emails';\n\n/**\n * Unlock credit after redemption confirmation\n */\nexport async function unlockCreditForRedemption(\n  redemptionId: string,\n  merchantId: string\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findUnique({\n    where: { id: redemptionId },\n    include: {\n      referral: {\n        include: {\n          referrer: true,\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!redemption || !redemption.referral) {\n    throw new Error('Redemption not found or has no referral');\n  }\n\n  if (redemption.merchantId !== merchantId) {\n    throw new Error('Merchant mismatch');\n  }\n\n  // Find locked credit for this redemption\n  const lockedCredit = await prisma.creditLedger.findFirst({\n    where: {\n      merchantId,\n      source: 'referral_redemption',\n      sourceId: redemptionId,\n      status: 'locked',\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!lockedCredit) {\n    // Credit might already be unlocked or doesn't exist\n    return;\n  }\n\n  // Unlock the credit\n  await prisma.creditLedger.update({\n    where: { id: lockedCredit.id },\n    data: {\n      status: 'available',\n    },\n  });\n\n  // Send email notification\n  if (redemption.referral.referrer.email)\n}",

'@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport Link from 'next/link';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\n\nexport default async function MerchantDashboardPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) redirect('/login');\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({ where: { slug: params.slug } });\n  if (!merchant) notFound();\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const dayStart = startOfDay(now);\n  const weekStart = startOfWeek(now, { weekStartsOn: 1 });\n\n  const [\n    activeVouchers,\n    activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.voucher.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'published' } }),\n    prisma.campaign.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'active' } }),\n    prisma.event.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'published' } }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, createdAt: { gte: dayStart } },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, createdAt: { gte: weekStart } },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, confirmedAt: null },\n    }),\n    prisma.creditLedger.aggregate({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Revenue: sum of paid voucher purchases\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate\n\n;\n}",
