        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport ConfirmRedemptionButton from './confirm-button';\nimport ExportRedemptionsButton from './export-button';\nimport Breadcrumbs from '@/components/navigation/breadcrumbs';\nimport { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';\nimport { CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';\n\nexport default async function RedemptionsPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  const t = await getTranslations('nav');\n  const tRedemption = await getTranslations('redemption');\n\n  const redemptions = await prisma.redemption.findMany({\n    where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: true,\n      referral: {\n        include: {\n          referrer: {\n            select: { name: true, email: true },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    },\n    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    take: 50,\n  });\n}",

        "contents": "## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   ├── credits.ts        # Credit management\n│   └── merchant-status.ts # Launch mode (kill switch, feature flags)\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   ├── seed.ts           # Seed script\n│   └── migrations/       # Database migrations\n├── scripts/              # Utility scripts\n│   ├── verify-mvp-setup.ts    # Verify MVP setup\n│   ├── test-launch-mode.ts    # Test launch mode\n│   └── check-migrations.ts    # Check migration status\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

          {
            "text": "# Voucher Rules",

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport Link from 'next/link';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport Breadcrumbs from '@/components/navigation/breadcrumbs';\nimport { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';\nimport VouchersListClient from './vouchers-list-client';\n\nexport default async function VouchersListPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) redirect('/login');\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({ where: { slug: params.slug } });\n  if (!merchant) notFound();\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  const t = await getTranslations('nav');\n  const tVoucher = await getTranslations('voucher');\n\n  const vouchers = await prisma.voucher.findMany({\n    where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    include: { _count: { select: { redemptions: true } } },\n  });\n\n  // Serialize dates to strings and designJson for client component\n  const serializedVouchers = vouchers.map((voucher) =&gt; ({\n    ...voucher,\n    validFrom: voucher.validFrom.toISOString(),\n    validTo: voucher.validTo.toISOString(),\n    designJson: voucher.designJson\n      ?         "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  let voucherId: string | undefined;\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const parsed = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n    voucherId = parsed.voucherId;\n    const { friendHint } = parsed;\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: parsed.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}&#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n      isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}\n    /&gt;\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst ;\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,\n        method: data.method,\n        orderReference: data.orderReference,\n        amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,\n        discountApplied: data.discountApplied,\n        currency: data.currency,\n        confirmedAt: null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError(tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn'));\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('showQrToStaff'));\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('discountApplied', { amount: formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency) }));\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchantSlug = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('merchantSlug');\n    if (!merchantSlug) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant slug required' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: merchantSlug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n    const redemptions = await prisma.redemption.findMany({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { id: true, type: true },\n        },\n        referral: {\n          include: {\n            referrer: {\n              select: { name: true, email: true },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    // Generate CSV\n    const headers = [\n      'ID',\n      'Voucher ID',\n      'Voucher Type',\n      'Method',\n      'Order Reference',\n      'Amount Before Discount',\n      'Discount Applied',\n      'Currency',\n      'Referrer',\n      'Confirmed At',\n      'Created At',\n    ];\n\n    const rows = redemptions.map((r) =&gt; [\n      r.id,\n      r.voucher.id,\n      r.voucher.type,\n      r.method,\n      r.orderReference || '',\n      String(r.amountBeforeDiscount / 100),\n      String(r.discountApplied / 100),\n      r.currency,\n      r.referral?.referrer?.email || '',\n      r.confirmedAt ? new Date(r.confirmedAt).toISOString() : '',\n      new Date(r.createdAt).toISOString(),\n    ]);\n\n    const csv = [\n      headers.join(','),\n      ...rows.map((row) =&gt; row.map((cell) =&gt; &#96;\"${cell}\"&#96;).join(',')),\n    ].join('\\n');\n\n    return new NextResponse(csv,\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check validity dates\n    const now = new Date();\n    if (now &lt; voucher.validFrom || now &gt; voucher.validTo) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher expired or not yet valid' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check usage limits\n    if (voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n      const totalRedemptions = await prisma.redemption.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          confirmedAt: { not: null },\n        },\n      });\n      if (totalRedemptions &gt;= voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher usage limit reached' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits\n    if (data.referralId &amp;&amp; session?.user?.id) {\n      const isSelf = await isSelfReferral(data.referralId, session.user.id);\n      if (isSelf) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cannot redeem your own referral' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        const rateLimit = await checkRedemptionRateLimit(referral.friendHash);\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Check rate limits for referral creation\n */\nexport async function checkReferralRateLimit(\n  userId: string,\n  windowMinutes: number = 60,\n  maxAttempts: number = 10\n): Promise&lt;{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number }&gt; {\n  const windowStart = new Date(Date.now() - windowMinutes * 60 * 1000);\n\n  const recentCount = await prisma.referral.count({\n    where: {\n      referrerUserId: userId,\n      createdAt: {\n        gte: windowStart,\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  return {\n    allowed: recentCount &lt; maxAttempts,\n    remaining: Math.max(0, maxAttempts - recentCount),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Check rate limits for redemption attempts\n */\nexport async function checkRedemptionRateLimit(\n  friendHash: string,\n  windowMinutes: number = 60,\n  maxAttempts: number = 5\n): Promise&lt;{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number }&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "interface VoucherClientProps {\n;\n  voucherCode: string;\n  qrCodeDataUrl: string;\n  isAuthenticated: boolean;\n  campaign?: any;\n}\n\nexport default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n  const [isPurchasing, setIsPurchasing] = useState(false);\n  const t = useTranslations('payment');\n  const tVoucher = useTranslations('voucher');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const tSuccess = useTranslations('success');\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n  \n  const hasPrice = campaign?.price !== null &amp;&amp; campaign?.price !== undefined;\n  const price = campaign?.price || 0;\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess(t('codeCopied'));\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handlePurchase = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!isAuthenticated) {\n      window.location.href = &#96;/login?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.href)}&#96;;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsPurchasing(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/vouchers/${voucher.id}/purchase&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({}),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const error = await res.json();\n        throw new Error(error.error || t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      if (data.url) {\n        window.location.href = data.url;\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t('purchaseFailed'));\n      setIsPurchasing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Handle errors and return appropriate HTTP response\n */\nexport function handleError(error: unknown): { status: number; error: string; code?: string } {\n  if (error instanceof AppError) {\n    return {\n      status: error.statusCode,\n      error: error.message,\n      code: error.code,\n    };\n  }\n\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\n    // In production, don't expose error details\n    const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';\n    return {\n      status: 500,\n      error: isProduction ? 'Internal server error' : error.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    status: 500,\n    error: 'Unknown error',\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { applyCredit } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst applyCreditSchema = z.object({\n  merchantSlug: z.string(),\n  amount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { merchantSlug, amount, orderReference } = applyCreditSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const result = await applyCredit(session.user.id, merchant.id, amount, orderReference || '');\n\n    return NextResponse.json(result);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Insufficient credit balance') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error applying credit:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport default function GlobalError({\n  error,\n  reset,\n}: {\n  error: Error &amp; { digest?: string };\n  reset: () =&gt; void;\n}) {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('Global error:', error);\n    }\n  }, [error]);\n\n  // Note: Global error cannot use next-intl hooks, so we use fallback text\n  // This is a critical error boundary that must work even if i18n fails\n  const errorStyles = &#96;\n    .ge-root { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }\n    .ge-h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n    .ge-p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 1rem; }\n    .ge-btn { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }\n  &#96;;\n  return (\n    &lt;html lang=\"en\"&gt;\n      &lt;head&gt;\n        &lt;style&gt;{errorStyles}&lt;/style&gt;\n      &lt;/head&gt;\n      &lt;body&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"ge-root\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"ge-h1\"&gt;Something went wrong&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"ge-p\"&gt;A critical error occurred. Please refresh the page.&lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;button type=\"button\" onClick={reset} className=\"ge-btn\"&gt;\n            Try again\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/body&gt;\n    &lt;/html&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "@tailwind base;\n@tailwind components;\n@tailwind utilities;\n\n/* Design: near-white bg, near-black text, 8pt grid, 150–250ms motion */\n:root {\n  --space-unit: 8px;\n  --motion-ease: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1);\n  --motion-duration: 200ms;\n}\n\n@layer base {\n  :root {\n    --background: 0 0% 100%;\n    --foreground: 222 47% 11%;\n    --card: 0 0% 100%;\n    --card-foreground: 222 47% 11%;\n    --popover: 0 0% 100%;\n    --popover-foreground: 222 47% 11%;\n    --primary: 222 47% 11%;\n    --primary-foreground: 0 0% 98%;\n    --secondary: 210 40% 96%;\n    --secondary-foreground: 222 47% 11%;\n    --muted: 210 40% 96%;\n    --muted-foreground: 215 16% 47%;\n    --accent: 142 71% 45%;\n    --accent-foreground: 0 0% 98%;\n    --destructive: 0 84% 60%;\n    --destructive-foreground: 0 0% 98%;\n    --border: 214 32% 91%;\n    --input: 214 32% 91%;\n    --ring: 222 47% 11%;\n    --radius: 1rem;\n    --radius-button: 0.75rem;\n  }\n\n  .dark {\n    --background: 220 15% 7%;\n    --foreground: 220 10% 95%;\n    --card: 220 15% 10%;\n    --card-foreground: 220 10% 95%;\n    --popover: 220 15% 10%;\n    --popover-foreground: 220 10% 95%;\n    --primary: 220 10% 95%;\n    --primary-foreground: 220 15% 10%;\n    --secondary: 220 12% 15%;\n    --secondary-foreground: 220 10% 95%;\n    --muted: 220 12% 15%;\n    --muted-foreground: 220 10% 55%;\n    --accent: 220 12% 15%;\n    --accent-foreground: 220 10% 95%;\n    --destructive: 0 55% 45%;\n    --destructive-foreground: 220 10% 95%;\n    --border: 220 12% 18%;\n    --input: 220 12% 18%;\n    --ring: 220 10% 60%;\n  }\n}\n\n@layer base {\n  * {\n    @apply border-border;\n  }\n  html {\n    scroll-behavior: smooth;\n  }\n  body {\n    @apply bg-background text-foreground antialiased;\n  }\n}\n\n@layer utilities {\n  .animate-in-success {\n    animation: success-in var(--motion-duration) var(--motion-ease) forwards;\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes success-in {\n  0% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(0.98); }",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "contents": "export default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n    let url = window.location.href;\n    if (isAuthenticated) {\n      try {\n        const res = await fetch('/api/referrals/create', {\n          method: 'POST',\n          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n          body: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: voucher.id }),\n        });\n        const data = await res.json();\n        if (data.shareUrl) url = data.shareUrl;\n      } catch {\n        // use /v/ link as fallback\n      }\n    }\n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: design?.headline || tVoucher('specialOffer'),\n          text: &#96;${tVoucher('checkOutVoucher')} ${voucher.merchant.name}&#96;,\n          url,\n        });\n        showSuccess(tVoucher('linkShared'));\n      } catch {\n        // cancelled or error\n      }\n    } else {\n      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);\n      showInfo(tVoucher('linkCopied'));\n    }\n    setIsSharing(false);\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "interface VoucherClientProps {\n;\n  voucherCode: string;\n  qrCodeDataUrl: string;\n  isAuthenticated: boolean;\n  campaign?: any;\n}\n\nexport default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n  const [isPurchasing, setIsPurchasing] = useState(false);\n  const t = useTranslations('payment');\n  const tVoucher = useTranslations('voucher');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const tSuccess = useTranslations('success');\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n  \n  const hasPrice = campaign?.price !== null &amp;&amp; campaign?.price !== undefined;\n  const price = campaign?.price || 0;\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess(t('codeCopied'));\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handlePurchase = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!isAuthenticated) {\n      window.location.href = &#96;/login?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.href)}&#96;;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsPurchasing(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/vouchers/${voucher.id}/purchase&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({}),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const error = await res.json();\n        throw new Error(error.error || t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      if (data.url) {\n        window.location.href = data.url;\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t('purchaseFailed'));\n      setIsPurchasing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n  try {\n    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text);\n  } catch {\n    return '';\n  }\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n      isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}\n    /&gt;\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError(tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn'));\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('showQrToStaff'));\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('discountApplied', { amount: formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency) }));\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n Kontrollisin ja parandasin kõik funktsioonid. Kokkuvõte:

## Parandatud funktsioonid

### 1. Kampaania leht (`/campaigns`)

**Parandatud:**
- Error handling — `isMerchantActive` on try-catch'is, et vältida vigu, kui merchant puudub
- Linkid — eemaldatud merchant dashboard linkid (nõuavad autentimist), asendatud avalike voucherite linkidega
- DiscountRules kontroll — kontrollitakse, et `type` ja `value` on olemas enne kasutamist
- Voucherite linkid — kõik linkid viitavad avalikele `/v/[id]` lehtedele

**Funktsioonid:**
- Kuvab kõik aktiivsed kampaaniad
- Filtreerib inaktiivsed merchant'id
- Näitab discount infot (kui on)
- Näitab hinda või "TASUTA" märget
- Näitab voucherite eelvaadet
- Linkid töötavad korrektselt

### 2. App leht (`/app`)

**Parandatud:**
- Referral stats — lisatud error handling, kui `groupBy` ebaõnnestub, kasutatakse `count`
- Credit balance — lisatud try-catch iga merchant'i jaoks, et vältida vigu
- Kampaania link — lisatud link kampaania lehele

**Funktsioonid:**
- Quick Stats (krediidid, piletid, merchant'id)
- Share & Generate sektsioon (referral statistikaga)
- Quick Actions (kampaaniaid, pileteid, makseid, profiili)
- Merchant Memberships

### 3. Üldised parandused

- Error handling — kõik andmebaasi päringud on kaitstud
- Null checks — kontrollitakse, et väärtused on olemas enne kasutamist
- Linkid — kõik linkid viitavad õigetele lehtedele
- Type safety — TypeScript tüübid on korrektsed

Kõik funktsioonid peaksid nüüd töötama korralikult.

        "contents": "# How to Add a New Locale\n\nThe platform uses &#96;next-intl&#96; for internationalization. Currently, English (&#96;en&#96;) is the default locale.\n\n## Adding a New Locale\n\n1. **Add locale to configuration**:\n   Edit &#96;i18n.ts&#96; and add your locale to the &#96;locales&#96; array:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   export const locales = ['en', 'es', 'fr'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Create translation file**:\n   Create &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; (e.g., &#96;messages/es.json&#96;) with translations:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n   {\n     \"common\": {\n       \"welcome\": \"Bienvenido\",\n       \"loading\": \"Cargando...\",\n       \"error\": \"Error\",\n       \"success\": \"Éxito\"\n     },\n     \"voucher\": {\n       \"share\": \"Compartir Cupón\",\n       \"redeem\": \"Canjear\",\n       \"expired\": \"Expirado\"\n     }\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Update middleware** (if needed):\n   The middleware can detect locale from headers or URL segments. Update &#96;middleware.ts&#96; if you want locale-based routing.\n\n4. **Use translations in components**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n   \n   function MyComponent() {\n     const t = useTranslations('common');\n     return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Locale Detection\n\nThe platform can detect locale from:\n- URL path prefix (e.g., &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;)\n- Accept-Language header\n- User preference (stored in session)\n\n## Currency Formatting\n\nCurrency formatting is handled by &#96;formatCurrency&#96; in &#96;lib/utils.ts&#96;, which uses &#96;Intl.NumberFormat&#96;. The currency code comes from the merchant's &#96;defaultCurrency&#96; field.",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis - 13 keelt!\n\nPlatvorm toetab nüüd **13 keelt**:\n\n1. **en** - English (Inglise) - vaikimisi\n2. **et** - Eesti (Eesti)\n3. **es** - Español (Hispaania)\n4. **fr** - Français (Prantsuse)\n5. **de** - Deutsch (Saksa)\n6. **fi** - Suomi (Soome) ⭐ UUS\n7. **sv** - Svenska (Rootsi) ⭐ UUS\n8. **no** - Norsk (Norra) ⭐ UUS\n9. **da** - Dansk (Taani) ⭐ UUS\n10. **lv** - Latviešu (Läti) ⭐ UUS\n11. **lt** - Lietuvių (Leedu) ⭐ UUS\n12. **pl** - Polski (Poola) ⭐ UUS\n13. **uk** - Українська (Ukraina) ⭐ UUS\n\n## 📁 Failid\n\nKõik tõlke failid on &#96;messages/&#96; kaustas:\n- &#96;messages/en.json&#96; - Inglise (vaikimisi)\n- &#96;messages/et.json&#96; - Eesti\n- &#96;messages/es.json&#96; - Hispaania\n- &#96;messages/fr.json&#96; - Prantsuse\n- &#96;messages/de.json&#96; - Inglise (vaikimisi)\n- &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96; - Eesti\n- &#96;/fi/v/[id]&#96; - Soome\n- &#96;/sv/v/[id]&#96; - Rootsi\n- &#96;/no/v/[id]&#96; - Norra\n- &#96;/da/v/[id]&#96; - Taani\n- &#96;/lv/v/[id]&#96;         "contents": "- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.\n- **wait-for-db.ps1:** TcpClient to &#96;127.0.0.1:5432&#96;.\n- **dev:full:** &#96;docker compose up -d postgres&#96;, then wait-for-db, db push, seed, ensure-test-user.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Seed ✅\n\n- Merchants: Coffee House, Tech Store.\n- Users: [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com), [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (upsert).\n- [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is member of Coffee House (merchant_admin).\n- Vouchers, referral, redemption, credit, audit log.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Known / Non-blocking\n\n- **next-intl:** &#96;getRequestConfig&#96; &#96;locale&#96; is deprecated in favor of &#96;requestLocale&#96;; non-blocking.\n- **i18n:** &#96;getRequestConfig&#96; must return &#96;locale&#96;; next major may require it.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Quick Run\n\n**Option A — dev:full (Docker):**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run dev:full\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Option B — manual:**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ndocker compose up -d postgres\n# wait a few seconds\nnpm run db:push\nnpm run db:seed\nnpm run db:ensure-test-user\nnpm run dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThen: &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt; → [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 → /app.",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "Reegel:",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "UI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "EI TOHI nõuda login’it",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "PEAVAD avanema &lt;1s",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "PEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "Jagamine peab olema 1 tap.",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "Credit ≠ raha",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "Credit on merchant-põhine",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "Credit:",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "algul locked",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "available ainult pärast redemption confirm",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "aegub",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "Self-referral on keelatud",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "Weekly Drop:",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "limited stock",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "kui otsas → otsas",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "Kõik write’id:",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "transaction’iga",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "server-side validatsioon",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "Ära salvesta:",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID",

          },
          {

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { Suspense } from 'react';\nimport { signIn } from 'next-auth/react';\nimport { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';\nimport { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { Chrome, Apple, Facebook, Github, Twitter, Linkedin } from 'lucide-react';\n\nconst TEST_EMAIL = 'test@example.com';\nconst TEST_PASSWORD = 'test123';\n\nfunction LoginForm() {\n  const t = useTranslations('auth');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const searchParams = useSearchParams();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  const callbackUrl = searchParams.get('callbackUrl') ?? '/app';\n\n  const handleCredentialsSignIn = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const res = await signIn('credentials', { email, password, callbackUrl, redirect: false });\n    setIsLoading(false);\n    if (res?.error) {\n      setError('Vale e‑post või parool.');\n      return;\n    }\n    if (res?.ok) {\n      window.location.href = res.url ?? callbackUrl;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleEmailSignIn = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    await signIn('email', { email, callbackUrl });\n    setIsLoading(false);\n  };\n}",
